scope: Two disjoint256-record assignments; every saved abstract string read in full. One source string (MED39392349) is a Significance section only and remains explicitly incomplete upstream. Source/ID records include reviews, preprints and publication versions, not independent drug experiments or full-text appraisals. Historical flags remain unchanged by separate primary follow-up.

records.title: Immunological role and prognostic value of the SKA family in pan-cancer analysis.

administered_agents.name: anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapies
administered_agents.role: response-prediction cohort class; individual agents unspecified

records.model: Pan-cancer public datasets and breast immunohistochemistry
records.note: SKA score associates with cell-cycle activity, immune suppression and checkpoint-immunotherapy response; drug database correlations do not demonstrate BUB1B restoration.
records.uncertainty: Candidate small molecules and chemotherapy agents are unnamed in the saved abstract.

records.title: Robust induction of interferon and interferon-stimulated gene expression by influenza B/Yamagata lineage virus infection of A549 cells.
records.note: IBV infection robustly induces interferon and interferon-stimulated transcripts; interferon is a host response here, not an administered rescue.
records.uncertainty: No drug or BUB1B-directed intervention is described.

records.title: Global gene expression analysis combined with a genomics approach for the identification of signal transduction networks involved in postnatal mouse myocardial proliferation and development.
records.model: Mouse hearts at 24 hours, 7 days and 10 weeks
records.note: Postnatal heart profiling links proliferation loss to cell-cycle and metabolic changes; BMPs and IGF1 are measured genes rather than administered cardiac therapies.
records.uncertainty: Expression differences do not establish a means of restoring cardiomyocyte proliferation.

records.title: The CCR4-NOT complex suppresses untimely translational activation of maternal mRNAs.
records.note: Loss of CCR4-NOT deadenylase activity causes untimely maternal-mRNA translation, meiosis-I arrest and female sterility.
records.uncertainty: Genetic checkpoint-adjacent mechanism; no drug rescue.

records.title: MIS12 Is Required for Kinetochore-Microtubule Attachment in Oocyte Meiosis.
records.model: Mouse and human oocytes; Mis12 conditional knockout mice
records.note: MIS12 depletion disrupts kinetochore attachment and checkpoint signaling, with direct tubulin binding implicated independently of NDC80.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic loss-of-function study; no administered candidate.

records.title: Global Phosphoproteomic Mapping of Early Mitotic Exit in Human Cells Identifies Novel Substrate Dephosphorylation Motifs.
records.model: Human cells during early mitotic exit
records.note: Only about 10% of mapped phosphosites dephosphorylate early, enriched on spindle, checkpoint and nuclear-envelope proteins; sequence context suggests phosphatase selectivity.
records.uncertainty: Any synchronization or chemical trigger is unnamed in the abstract.

records.title: The dependence of shugoshin on Bub1-kinase activity is dispensable for the maintenance of spindle assembly checkpoint response in Cryptococcus neoformans.
records.note: Sgo1 loss shifts kinetochore Aurora-B/PP1 balance and prematurely terminates checkpoint signaling; Bub1 kinase activity is dispensable for Sgo1 localization in this yeast.
records.uncertainty: Bub1 is not BUB1B; fungal mechanism does not establish a human treatment.

records.title: Influence of fatty acid diets on gene expression in rat mammary epithelial cells.
records.model: Rat mammary ductal epithelium during puberty
records.note: All enriched-fat test diets raise mammary proliferation and cell-cycle expression relative to the reference diet; the authors infer possible later cancer risk.
records.uncertainty: Cancer incidence and BUB1B rescue were not demonstrated.

records.title: Study of the Cytotoxic and Wound Healing Activity of Polysaccharides from <i>Bovistella utriformis</i>.
records.model: HaCaT keratinocyte scratch assays and zebrafish caudal-fin regeneration
records.note: PsBU improves scratch closure at 500 micrograms/mL and fin regeneration at 200 micrograms/mL, with repair-associated proteomic changes; this is actual tissue-repair evidence outside MVA.
records.uncertainty: Extract composition, robust safety and BUB1B dependence need primary appraisal; high-dose viability data alone do not establish safety.

records.title: Muscle Transcriptome Analysis of Mink at Different Growth Stages Using RNA-Seq.
records.model: Mink pectoral muscle at 45, 90 and 120 days
records.note: Early muscle growth correlates with cell-cycle/FGF expression and later growth with contractile and skeletal-muscle genes.
records.uncertainty: No administered FGF, muscle-compensation treatment or BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Somatic mosaicism in the human genome.
records.note: Reviews mutation scale, developmental timing and methods for detecting mosaicism, including cancer and neurodegeneration.
records.uncertainty: No named administered therapy or functional rescue in the abstract.

records.title: Time-course transcriptional profiling of human amniotic fluid-derived stem cells using microarray.
records.note: Passaging nearly extinguishes NPPB and increases FOLR3 expression; senescence roles are proposed from expression, with selected PCR discrepancies acknowledged.
records.uncertainty: NPPB/FOLR3 causality and intervention effects were not tested in the abstract.

records.title: Lappaol F regulates the cell cycle by activating CDKN1C/p57 in human colorectal cancer cells.
records.model: SW480, HCT15 and HCT116 colorectal cancer cells
records.note: Lappaol F at 25–75 micromolar induces S-phase arrest; CDKN1C/p57 knockdown attenuates inhibition, supporting a p57-dependent antitumor mechanism.
records.uncertainty: Cancer cytostasis is not BUB1B-deficiency rescue.

records.title: Regulation of steroid hormone receptors and coregulators during the cell cycle highlights potential novel function in addition to roles as transcription factors.

administered_agents.name: steroid hormones
administered_agents.role: reviewed signaling class, not a specified administration

records.note: Discusses receptor/coregulator functions during G2/M beyond transcription and reciprocal interactions with mitotic kinases.
records.uncertainty: No specific therapeutic steroid or functional rescue is named.

records.title: Spindle checkpoint requires Mad1-bound and Mad1-free Mad2.
records.note: Excess Mad1/Mad1C sequesters free Mad2 and abolishes checkpoint function; kinetochore-binding Mad1N also disrupts maintenance, showing critical Mad1:Mad2 stoichiometry.
records.uncertainty: Extract-level protein mechanism, with no administered patient candidate.

records.title: Senataxin: A New Guardian of the Female Germline Important for Delaying Ovarian Aging.
records.note: SETX-mediated repair is linked to preserved follicle reserves and reduced persistent oocyte DNA damage during oxidative aging.
records.uncertainty: SETX is an endogenous repair protein, not an administered drug; no pharmacological rescue is named.

records.title: BUB-1-bound PLK-1 directs CDC-20 kinetochore recruitment to ensure timely embryonic mitoses.
records.note: BUB-1-bound PLK-1 phosphorylates an ABBA motif to recruit CDC-20 and set checkpoint-independent embryonic mitotic timing.
records.uncertainty: BUB-1 is not human BUB1B; no chemical treatment is identified.

records.title: Mitogenic Signals Stimulate the CREB Coactivator CRTC3 through PP2A Recruitment.
records.note: Mitogenic ERK/CDK phosphorylation of CRTC3 S391 recruits B55-PP2A, enabling subsequent activating dephosphorylation and growth-factor/cAMP cross-talk.
records.uncertainty: Stimuli are not individually named; no functional rescue or BUB1B intervention.

records.title: Subacute cannabidiol alters genome-wide DNA methylation in adult mouse hippocampus.
records.model: Adult male a/a Agouti viable yellow mice; hippocampus
records.note: CBD produces 3,323 differentially methylated loci with slight overall hypomethylation and enrichment near neuronal-function genes.
records.uncertainty: The measured endpoint is methylation, not improved behavior, BUB1B restoration or neurological rescue.

records.title: A novel molecular diagnostics platform for somatic and germline precision oncology.

administered_agents.name: gefitinib
administered_agents.role: administered EGFR-targeted therapy in one reclassified lung-cancer case

records.model: Cancer sequencing platform and individual patient
records.note: An EGFR deletion-insertion led to reclassification of presumed breast metastasis as lung cancer and gefitinib treatment with a 15-month partial response.
records.uncertainty: Single oncology case; no MVA-directed treatment demonstrated.

records.title: Chemoresistance in Pancreatic Cancer: The Role of Adipose-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells and Key Resistance Genes.
records.model: Capan-1 pancreatic cancer cells and adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells
records.note: Both drugs reduce Capan-1 viability while ASCs remain resistant; oxaliplatin strongly reprograms the ASC secretome toward immune evasion, matrix remodeling and tumor support.
records.uncertainty: Secretome findings do not establish patient outcomes or a BUB1B rescue mechanism.

records.title: Bone morphogenetic protein 1: a prognostic indicator and potential biomarker in three cancer types.
records.model: Bladder, clear-cell kidney and lung adenocarcinoma datasets and tissues
records.note: High BMP1 expression associates with shorter survival and extracellular-matrix pathways in three cancers.
records.uncertainty: BMP1 is a measured metalloprotease, not administered bone morphogenetic therapy.

records.title: The Pathogenesis of Atherosclerosis Based on Human Signaling Networks and Stem Cell Expression Data.
records.note: Risk modules reconstructed from signaling networks distinguish disease and normal samples and suggest stem-cell-related biomarkers.
records.uncertainty: No intervention or measured vascular rescue.

records.title: Identification of cancer stem cell-related biomarkers in intestinal-type and diffuse-type gastric cancer by stemness index and weighted correlation network analysis.
records.model: Intestinal and diffuse gastric cancer datasets
records.note: Stemness-network analysis identifies 16 and 43 subtype-specific cell-cycle genes as candidate targets.
records.uncertainty: Target nomination lacks administered agents and functional treatment evidence.

records.title: Comprehensive circular RNA expression profiling constructs a ceRNA network and identifies hsa_circ_0000673 as a novel oncogene in distal cholangiocarcinoma.
records.model: Distal cholangiocarcinoma tissues and CCA cells
records.note: Inhibiting hsa_circ_0000673 reduces CCA proliferation, migration and invasion after its diagnostic and clinicopathological association was established.
records.uncertainty: RNA inhibition modality is unnamed; circRNA is a molecular target rather than a drug.

records.title: The essential role of primary cilia in cerebral cortical development and disorders.
records.model: Primary cilia in cortical progenitors, neurons and glia
records.note: Reviews ciliary signal integration in cortical development and neurodevelopmental disorders, identifying translation to treatment as a future challenge.
records.uncertainty: No administered neurological rescue agent in the abstract.

records.title: The AAA+ ATPase TRIP13 remodels HORMA domains through N-terminal engagement and unfolding.
records.model: Purified TRIP13/MAD2 complexes, cells and mouse spermatocytes
records.note: TRIP13 engages and unfolds MAD2 through its N terminus with p31comet assistance; MAD2/HORMAD1 truncations block remodeling and disrupt checkpoint or meiotic removal.
records.uncertainty: Proteins and ATP are mechanistic reagents; no therapeutic compound tested.

records.title: Single-Cell Atlas of the Chinese Tongue Sole (Cynoglossus semilaevis) Ovary Reveals Transcriptional Programs of Oogenesis in Fish.
records.model: Adult Chinese tongue sole ovary with macaque comparison
records.note: Single-cell profiling resolves germline and follicular cell states and conserved oogenesis programs.
records.uncertainty: Hormones/growth factors are contextual signaling, with no administered treatment.

records.title: Microtubules oppose cortical actomyosin-driven membrane ingression during C. elegans meiosis I polar body extrusion.
records.model: C. elegans oocyte meiosis-I and cls-2 mutants
records.note: Nocodazole increases cortical membrane ingression; taxol reduces it and suppresses excess ingression in cls-2 mutants, supporting microtubule stiffness opposing actomyosin.
records.uncertainty: Rescues a specific worm cortical phenotype, not BUB1B function, euploidy or organismal MVA.

records.title: Pilomatricomas in a patient with Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome: diagnostic and therapeutic clues.
records.model: 17-year-old patient with Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome and pilomatricomas
records.note: Ultrasound and genetics identify syndromic multiple pilomatricomas; surgical resection is recommended given possible complications.
records.uncertainty: No drug treatment or postoperative outcome is stated.

records.title: Applications of Genome-wide Screening of CRISPR/Cas9 Knockout Library in Identifying Novel Molecular Targets for Xenobiotics.
records.note: Reviews knockout-screen applications to toxin mechanisms, tumor vulnerabilities, drug resistance and pathogen host factors.
records.uncertainty: No specific xenobiotic, antidote or rescue agent is identified.

records.title: Interaction of P2 purinergic receptors with cellular macromolecules.
records.note: Describes receptor oligomerization and cross-talk with ion channels, integrins and kinase signaling across different time scales.
records.uncertainty: Ligands are reviewed physiological agonists, with no therapeutic administration or rescue result.

records.title: Molecular characterisation of transport mechanisms at the developing mouse blood-CSF interface: a transcriptome approach.
records.model: Embryonic-day-15 and adult mouse choroid plexus
records.note: SPARC/GYPA expression and localization coincide with embryonic albumin transport, motivating a developmental blood-CSF transport model.
records.uncertainty: Albumin is transported endogenous cargo; no drug-delivery or therapeutic rescue experiment is reported.

records.title: Senescence- and Immunity-Related Changes in the Central Nervous System: A Comprehensive Review.
records.model: Central nervous system senescence and immune regulation
records.note: Reviews how neuronal/glial SASP and senescent immune cells affect development, aging, degeneration and injury.
records.uncertainty: No named senolytic, senomorphic or measured CNS rescue in the saved abstract.

records.title: MISP is a novel Plk1 substrate required for proper spindle orientation and mitotic progression.
records.note: MISP depletion shortens astral microtubules, misorients spindles and impairs metaphase-to-anaphase transition, implicating Plk1 phosphorylation and p150glued positioning.
records.uncertainty: No administered drug or BUB1B restoration experiment.

records.title: The Phosphorylation Status of Drp1-Ser637 by PKA in Mitochondrial Fission Modulates Mitophagy via PINK1/Parkin to Exert Multipolar Spindles Assembly during Mitosis.
records.note: Rotenone, antimycin A and Mdivi-1 disturb Drp1 phosphorylation and mitotic control; PKA-associated Drp1-Ser637 mitophagy accompanies multipolar spindles. Dynasore lacks the reported Drp1 phosphorylation effect.
records.uncertainty: More mitophagy is not a beneficial endpoint here; off-target effects and BUB1B-deficient relevance remain untested.

records.title: MEX-5 asymmetry in one-cell C. elegans embryos requires PAR-4- and PAR-1-dependent phosphorylation.
records.note: PAR-1/PAR-4-dependent phosphorylation of MEX-5 S458 increases posterior mobility to generate anterior asymmetry without directed transport or degradation.
records.uncertainty: Developmental protein mechanism; no pharmacological candidate.

records.title: Re-analysis of protein data reveals the germination pathway and up accumulation mechanism of cell wall hydrolases during the radicle protrusion step of seed germination in Podophyllum hexandrum- a high altitude plant.
records.note: Reanalysis nominates interacting signaling, metabolism and cell-wall proteins during radicle protrusion.
records.uncertainty: Medicinal plant identity does not imply administered podophyllotoxin or any human therapy.

records.title: Phospho-regulation of mitotic spindle assembly.
records.note: Reviews kinase/phosphatase substrates controlling centriole duplication, centrosome maturation and bipolar spindle establishment.
records.uncertainty: No named chemical intervention or rescue is present.

records.title: Single cell transcriptomic analysis of the immune cell compartment in the human small intestine and in Celiac disease.
records.model: Human small-intestinal immune cells in celiac disease
records.note: Patients on a gluten-free diet show only partial normalization of immune-cell transcriptomes, while active disease changes myeloid and T-cell states.
records.uncertainty: Observational molecular restoration is not demonstrated BUB1B or intestinal functional rescue.

records.title: ATRT-08. A PHASE II STUDY OF CONTINUOUS LOW DOSE PANOBINOSTAT IN PAEDIATRIC PATIENTS WITH MALIGNANT RHABDOID TUMORS/ATYPICAL TERATOID RHABDOID TUMORS
records.note: Panobinostat increases blood-cell H4 acetylation; six of seven remain on study at interim reporting, one progresses, and myelosuppression limits dosing.
records.uncertainty: Conference abstract and small uncontrolled interim cohort; retention and acetylation do not establish efficacy or MVA benefit.

records.title: AUK3 is required for faithful nuclear segregation in the bloodstream form of Trypanosoma brucei
records.note: TbAUK3 RNAi reduces proliferation and DNA synthesis, disrupts nuclear segregation and increases genomic instability and genotoxin sensitivity.
records.uncertainty: Preprint source; genotoxic agents are unnamed and this is a parasite Aurora kinase, not BUB1B restoration.

records.title: Identification of Key Genes via Integrated Multi-Omics and Machine Learning Uncovers Tumor Biological Features and Prognostic Biomarkers in Uterine Leiomyosarcoma.
records.note: Cell-cycle/p53/DNA-repair genes discriminate ULMS and correlate with immune states, but Mendelian randomization finds no genetic causality.
records.uncertainty: Diagnostic associations cannot establish that manipulating these genes treats disease.

records.title: Maternal factors required for oocyte developmental competence in mice: transcriptome analysis of non-surrounded nucleolus (NSN) and surrounded nucleolus (SN) oocytes.
records.note: Competent SN oocytes differ in phosphatidylinositol metabolism and maternal-factor accumulation from poorly developing NSN oocytes.
records.uncertainty: Metabolites are inferred pathway products; no administered maturation rescue.

records.title: Case Report: A BRCA2 Mutation Identified Through Next-Generation Sequencing in a Birt-Hogg-Dubè Syndrome Family.
records.model: Birt-Hogg-Dube family with FLCN and BRCA2 variants
records.note: Sequencing identifies concurrent pathogenic FLCN and BRCA2 variants, supporting more targeted cancer surveillance.
records.uncertainty: No administered treatment or BUB1B evidence.

records.title: The Biological and Molecular Function of LINC00665 in Human Cancers.
records.note: Reviews oncogenic associations and effects of LINC00665 on proliferation, invasion and apoptosis.
records.uncertainty: LINC00665 is an RNA target; no named drug or rescue in the abstract.

records.title: DNA lesions induced by replication stress trigger mitotic aberration and tetraploidy development.
records.note: Replication-stress lesions evade effective checkpoints, persist into mitosis and produce segregation failure, failed cytokinesis and tetraploidy.
records.uncertainty: No named chemical inducer or protective treatment is supplied.

records.title: DNA Damaged Induced Cell Death in Oocytes.
records.note: Reviews p53-family, particularly p63, elimination of damaged oocytes and chemotherapy-associated infertility, with fertility-preservation intervention discussed.
records.uncertainty: Specific protective agents are absent from the abstract and require source identification.

records.title: Splicing factors Sf3A2 and Prp31 have direct roles in mitotic chromosome segregation.

administered_agents.name: anti-Sf3A2 antibody
administered_agents.role: experimental inhibitory antibody injected into embryos

administered_agents.name: anti-Prp31 antibody
administered_agents.role: experimental inhibitory antibody injected into embryos

records.note: Antibody injection disrupts division within one minute, supporting direct mitotic roles of splicing factors in Ndc80/microtubule attachment rather than delayed splicing effects.
records.uncertainty: Experimental antibodies are checkpoint-disrupting reagents, not rescue therapeutics.

records.title: circMORC3-encoded novel protein negatively regulates antiviral immunity through synergizing with host gene MORC3.
records.model: Miichthys miiuy antiviral signaling and SCRV infection
records.note: circMORC3 encodes MORC3-84aa, which promotes TRIF autophagic degradation through K6 ubiquitination; host MORC3 additionally suppresses IRF3 and supports viral immune escape.
records.uncertainty: Encoded peptide and host gene are mechanistic entities, not administered clinical drugs.

records.title: Cryptotanshinone Is a Intervention for ER-Positive Breast Cancer: An Integrated Approach to the Study of Natural Product Intervention Mechanisms.
records.model: MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells
records.note: Cryptotanshinone preferentially inhibits MCF-7 proliferation/migration and lowers CDK1/CCNA2; ESR1 expression is unchanged despite the broad mechanistic conclusion.
records.uncertainty: Abstract's ESR1 mechanism exceeds its stated expression result; no BUB1B rescue.

records.title: CRISPR-cas9 Screening Identified Lethal Genes Enriched in Cell Cycle Pathway and of Prognosis Significance in Breast Cancer.
records.model: Breast cancer CRISPR dependency and patient datasets
records.note: Eighty-six overexpressed essential genes enrich cell-cycle pathways; a 51-gene score predicts recurrence and nominates vulnerabilities.
records.uncertainty: Pooled dependency/association results do not identify an administered therapy.

records.title: A negative genetic interaction map in isogenic cancer cell lines reveals cancer cell vulnerabilities.
records.model: Isogenic cancer lines with orthogonal co-culture validation
records.note: Negative-interaction mapping identifies differentially essential genes, including a PTEN-null dependency signature transferable to other cancer lines.
records.uncertainty: No named small molecule or correction of chromosomal instability.

records.title: Functional Genomics of PRUNE1 in Neurodevelopmental Disorders (NDDs) Tied to Medulloblastoma (MB) and Other Tumors.
records.model: PRUNE1 neurodevelopmental disorders and medulloblastoma literature
records.note: Reviews disrupting Prune_1/Nm23-H1 interactions and Wnt/TGF-beta signaling while connecting PRUNE1 loss-related neurodevelopmental disease to tumor biology.
records.uncertainty: Agent identities and whether inhibition benefits neurodevelopment versus cancer require source identification; opposing dosage effects matter.

records.title: Stable kinetochore-microtubule attachment is sufficient to silence the spindle assembly checkpoint in human cells.
records.note: Hyperstable kinetochore attachments silence the checkpoint even without biorientation or detectable tension, separating checkpoint satisfaction from correct segregation geometry.
records.uncertainty: Checkpoint silencing alone is not beneficial genome restoration; no drug tested.

records.title: Mitotic control of kinetochore-associated dynein and spindle orientation by human Spindly.
records.model: Human cells depleted of Spindly and/or dynein
records.note: Spindly depletion causes chromosome misalignment, unstable fibers and spindle rotation; dynein co-depletion rescues rotation while species differences in MAD2 removal remain.
records.uncertainty: A rescued orientation phenotype does not establish rescue of all mitotic defects or a pharmacological treatment.

records.title: Identification of bipotent progenitors that give rise to myogenic and connective tissues in mouse.
records.note: Myf5-positive progenitors generate both muscle and connective tissue in cranial mesoderm territories; disrupted myogenic identity redirects them to connective tissue.
records.uncertainty: No administered muscle-compensation or regenerative agent.

records.title: Decreased expression of H19/miR-675 ameliorates hypoxia-induced oxaliplatin resistance in colorectal cancer.

administered_agents.name: miR-675-3p mimic
administered_agents.role: experimental RNA reagent counteracting H19-deficiency effects

records.model: Hypoxic colorectal cancer cells and in vivo tumor model
records.note: H19 downregulation reduces hypoxia-associated oxaliplatin resistance; the miRNA mimic attenuates that effect, linking the axis to EMT.
records.uncertainty: Abstract descriptions of H19/miR-675 direction and sponging need mechanistic verification; no BUB1B restoration.

records.title: Regulation of the anaphase-promoting complex-separase cascade by transforming growth factor-beta modulates mitotic progression in bone marrow stromal cells.
records.note: Smad3 loss reduces APC phosphorylation, raises cyclin-B/CDK1 activity and hyperphosphorylates separase; separase S1126A abolishes that phosphorylation defect.
records.uncertainty: TGF-beta is discussed as signaling, with no explicit administered preparation; biochemical correction is not proven tissue rescue.

records.title: Cross-species transcriptome-wide meta-analysis of anterior cruciate ligament rupture.
records.model: Human, mouse, dog and rabbit ACL rupture datasets
records.note: Shared rupture responses involve mitosis, collagen and cartilage, including pathways consistent with reduced subchondral mineral density.
records.uncertainty: No ligament repair agent or measured treatment benefit.

records.title: Single-cell proteomics reveals decreased abundance of proteostasis and meiosis proteins in advanced maternal age oocytes.
records.model: Human oocytes from younger and advanced-age women
records.note: Older oocytes show reduced proteasome, TRiC and other meiosis/proteostasis proteins, nominating quality-related pathways.
records.uncertainty: Protein abundance differences do not establish a restoring intervention.

records.title: Validation of loci and genes associated with fertility in Holstein cows using gene-set enrichment analysis-SNP and genotype-by-sequencing.
records.note: Three loci associate with breedings required to conceive, implicating implantation/receptivity; no significant first-breeding locus is found.
records.uncertainty: Genomic-selection proposal, not administered fertility therapy.

records.title: In vivo FRET imaging revealed a regulatory role of RanGTP in kinetochore-microtubule attachments via Aurora B kinase.
records.model: Live-cell FRET analysis of kinetochore attachment
records.note: Post-metaphase RanGTP stabilizes attachment through NES-bearing Mst1 and Aurora-B regulation, maintaining alignment before segregation.
records.uncertainty: RanGTP is a signaling state rather than a named administered drug.

records.title: Accelerating aging research: how can we measure the rate of biologic aging?
records.note: Argues that premature-aging claims require standardized multidomain phenotypes because single aging-associated findings do not measure aging rate.
records.uncertainty: No treatment tested; relevant caution for extrapolating senescence markers into organismal benefit.

records.title: Kinetochore targeting of fission yeast Mad and Bub proteins is essential for spindle checkpoint function but not for all chromosome segregation roles of Bub1p.
records.note: Bub1 N-terminal targeting is needed for efficient checkpoint signaling but dispensable for other Bub1 chromosome-segregation functions.
records.uncertainty: Separates localization and noncheckpoint roles; no pharmacological intervention.

records.title: Real-Time Characterization of Clonal Fate Decisions in Complex Leukemia Samples by Fluorescent Genetic Barcoding.
records.model: AML clones in culture and transplanted mice
records.note: Longitudinal color barcoding tracks inherited competitive advantages without new exomic growth mutations and associates expansion with Myc/stem-cell/RAS programs.
records.uncertainty: Tracking and transplantation are experimental methods, not an AML or MVA treatment.

records.title: Senescent cells: A therapeutic target for osteoporosis.
records.model: Senescent bone cells in primary and secondary osteoporosis
records.note: Reviews cell-type and disease-context differences in bone senescence/SASP and proposes targeting senescence for osteoporosis.
records.uncertainty: Specific senolytic or other compounds and bone-functional results are not named in the abstract.

records.title: The Aurora B Kinase in Chromosome Bi-Orientation and Spindle Checkpoint Signaling.
records.note: Reviews Aurora-B roles in attachment, biorientation and checkpoint signaling, emphasizing unresolved feedback interactions.
records.uncertainty: No specific inhibitor or beneficial intervention is described.

records.title: R3HDM4 influences kidney renal clear cell carcinoma progression, immune modulation, and potential links to the IGSF8 immune checkpoint.
records.model: Clear-cell renal cancer tissues and cells
records.note: R3HDM4 knockdown suppresses proliferation/migration/invasion and EMT markers, while increasing IGSF8; the immune-checkpoint connection remains speculative.
records.uncertainty: Chemotherapy sensitivity is analyzed but individual drugs are unnamed; not BUB1B rescue.

records.title: MoMad2 With a Conserved Function in the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Is Required for Maintaining Appressorial Turgor Pressure and Pathogenicity of Rice Blast Fungus.
records.note: Rice-blast MoMad2 restores checkpoint arrest in fission-yeast mad2 deletion; its fungal deletion reduces turgor, penetration and pathogenicity.
records.uncertainty: Cross-species gene complementation is not drug rescue; challenge agent requires source identification if pursued.

records.title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals gene signatures and alterations associated with aging in distinct neural stem/progenitor cell subpopulations.
records.model: Young and aged mouse forebrain neural stem/progenitor cells
records.note: Aged inflammatory niches associate with astrocytic bias, whereas reduced proliferation appears cell intrinsic and linked to ERK/MAPK across distinct progenitor states.
records.uncertainty: No named cytokine exposure or drug rescue; distinguishes niche fate effects from intrinsic proliferation decline.

records.title: Identification and validation of a novel ubiquitination-related gene UBE2T in Ewing's sarcoma.
records.note: UBE2T is overexpressed, diagnostic and associated with adverse survival after cell-cycle-enriched network analysis.
records.uncertainty: Expression biomarker is not an administered ubiquitination inhibitor.

records.title: Markedly enhanced colon tumorigenesis in Apc(Min) mice lacking glutathione S-transferase Pi.
records.note: GSTP loss increases colon adenoma incidence sixfold and multiplicity fiftyfold, shortens survival and raises inflammatory genes/nitrotyrosine.
records.uncertainty: Warns that an enzyme overexpressed in tumors can also protect tissue; no glutathione administration tested.

records.title: PP2A-B' holoenzyme substrate recognition, regulation and role in cytokinesis.
records.model: Human PP2A-B-prime substrate motifs and cytokinesis
records.note: PP2A-binding motifs and phosphorylation tune substrate recognition; Plk1-primed Cyk4 recruits PP2A, which displaces Ect2 to spatially control the cleavage furrow.
records.uncertainty: Peptidome ligands are experimental binding sequences, not administered small-molecule PP2A activators.

records.title: Nucleotide-binding mechanisms in pseudokinases.
records.note: Pseudokinases differ markedly in nucleotide binding and catalysis, precluding function prediction from sequence; ATP often supplies structural regulation.
records.uncertainty: No named drug binds BUB1B in this abstract.

records.title: Aging and neoteny in the B lineage.
records.note: Proposes that altered homeostasis following cellular depletion can rejuvenate hematopoiesis.
records.uncertainty: Depletion agents and functional evidence are absent from the short abstract; source identification needed to distinguish renewal from marker change.

records.title: Impact of viral presence in tumor on gene expression in non-small cell lung cancer.
records.note: Viral-associated gene changes differ by histology, viral type and primary versus metastatic status.
records.uncertainty: No antiviral or anticancer treatment assessed.

records.title: MS275 as Class I HDAC inhibitor displayed therapeutic potential on malignant ascites by iTRAQ-based quantitative proteomic analysis.

administered_agents.name: abemaciclib
administered_agents.role: administered CDK4/6 inhibitor, also combined with MS275

records.model: Malignant-ascites cells and in vivo ascites-bearing model
records.note: MS275 preferentially arrests/kills ascites cells, reduces ascites volume from 7.5 to 2.9 mL and reportedly extends lifespan 66%; abemaciclib combination is synergistic.
records.uncertainty: Survival benefit is in a malignancy model and is not anti-aging or BUB1B-deficiency rescue; species/details require primary review.

records.title: Bioinformatics Analysis Identified Key Molecular Changes in Bladder Cancer Development and Recurrence.
records.model: Bladder cancer, surrounding and recurrent tissue datasets
records.note: CCNB1, ESPL1, CENPM, BLM and ASPM expression associates with cancer and survival; overlapping genes are nominated for recurrence.
records.uncertainty: No administered cell-cycle therapy.

records.title: Bicarbonate-Dependent Detoxification by Mitigating Ammonium-Induced Hypoxic Stress in Triticum aestivum Root.
records.note: Bicarbonate reverses ammonium-associated energy/fermentation abnormalities and alleviates root-growth suppression attributed to hypoxic stress.
records.uncertainty: Actual plant growth rescue does not imply mammalian bicarbonate therapy or BUB1B relevance.

records.title: Identification and validation of core genes for serous ovarian adenocarcinoma via bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Serous ovarian cancer datasets and clinical samples
records.note: KIF11 emerges as a cell-cycle hub and is elevated with aggressive tumor features; KIF11, CLDN3 and FGF13 associate with prognosis.
records.uncertainty: No kinesin inhibitor administered.

records.title: Molecular Pathogenesis of Hepatitis-B-virus-associated Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.note: Reviews chronic inflammation, viral integration and HBx-driven growth/survival in liver carcinogenesis.
records.uncertainty: Calls for prevention and antiviral treatment without naming or testing agents.

records.title: Stressing mitosis to death.
records.note: Reviews how stress can enforce mitotic arrest/death or enable premature exit and survival, affecting antimitotic chemotherapy efficacy.
records.uncertainty: No specific stressor or chemotherapy drug is named; cell clearance differs from repair.

records.title: Identification and Integrated Analysis of Key Biomarkers for Diagnosis and Prognosis of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
records.model: NSCLC tumor and control expression datasets
records.note: Mitotic hub genes including MAD2L1, CDC20 and KIF11 associate with poor survival and are proposed as diagnostic/target candidates.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic perturbation tests the candidate genes.

records.title: Diagnostic yield and clinical utility of a comprehensive gene panel for hereditary tumor syndromes.
records.model: Suspected and established hereditary tumor syndromes
records.note: Expanded sequencing finds potential causes in 17% of unexplained cases but clear causative variants in only 2%, with multi-gene findings complicating interpretation.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic outcome or administered agent.

records.title: Capturing functional long non-coding RNAs through integrating large-scale causal relations from gene perturbation experiments.

administered_agents.name: anti-PD-1 immunotherapy
administered_agents.role: response cohort class, specific agent unnamed

records.note: LnCAR uses perturbation-derived relationships to infer lncRNA functions; immune-evasion signatures associate with anti-PD-1 response.
records.uncertainty: Predictive signatures are not evidence that administering or inhibiting a lncRNA improves response.

records.title: Angiogenic and Immune Predictors of Neoadjuvant Axitinib Response in Renal Cell Carcinoma with Venous Tumour Thrombus
records.model: NAXIVA renal cancer patients with venous tumor thrombus
records.note: Reports prior 35% thrombus response and identifies vascular density, VEGF-A/PlGF induction and immune markers predictive of axitinib response.
records.uncertainty: Preprint correlative analysis and cancer endpoint; no MVA or vascular-restoration evidence.

records.title: Distinct p63 and p73 Protein Interactions Predict Specific Functions in mRNA Splicing and Polyploidy Control in Epithelia.
records.note: p73-specific partners emphasize APC/checkpoint and genome surveillance, while p63-specific partners emphasize RNA processing/splicing.
records.uncertainty: Protein-network inference is not administered p53-family therapy.

records.title: Hub genes and key pathways of non-small lung cancer identified using bioinformatics.
records.model: NSCLC public expression and survival datasets
records.note: BUB1B, named as mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine kinase B, is among highly connected genes whose elevated expression associates with lower survival.
records.uncertainty: Cancer coexpression does not show that BUB1B reduction is safe in deficient tissue; abstract mislabels CDK1 as cyclin-dependent kinase 9.

records.title: The Borealin dimerization domain interacts with Sgo1 to drive Aurora B-mediated spindle assembly.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts and biochemical complexes
records.note: Disrupting Sgo1-Borealin binding impairs CPC recruitment and Aurora-B spindle assembly while preserving checkpoint signaling at unattached kinetochores.
records.uncertainty: Demonstrates separable spindle/checkpoint functions; no drug rescue.

records.title: Cisplatin sensitivity mediated by NKX2-1 in lung adenocarcinoma is dependent on p53 mutational status via modulating TNFSF10 expression.
records.model: Six lung adenocarcinoma lines and 97 treated patients
records.note: Higher NKX2-1 associates with cisplatin sensitivity in p53-WT but resistance in p53-mutant tumors/cells, linked to TNFSF10 expression.
records.uncertainty: Treatment direction depends on p53 context; no universal benefit or BUB1B restoration.

records.title: Emerging role of SIRT2 in non-small cell lung cancer.
records.note: Reviews SIRT2 metabolism, stemness and autophagy, explicitly retaining both tumor-promoting and tumor-suppressive roles despite anticancer inhibitor reports.
records.uncertainty: Specific inhibitors and context-dependent safety require source identification; NAD dependence does not itself support niacin restoration.

records.title: A quantitative systems view of the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Spindle checkpoint measurements and computational models
records.note: Reviews local attachment-to-global inhibition signaling and the quantitative dynamics needed for robust checkpoint control.
records.uncertainty: No administered modulator or functional rescue.

records.title: Widening the spectrum of players affected by genetic changes in Wilms tumor relapse.
records.note: Relapse variants frequently affect DNA repair and chromatin genes, and nearly half of patients have germline anomalies.
records.uncertainty: Targeted therapies are proposed without specifying drugs or treated outcomes.

records.title: Developing a prognostic stratification model based on glutathione metabolism in thyroid cancer and validating RRM2's tumor-promoting role.
records.model: Thyroid cancer cohorts, TPC-1 cells and nude-mouse tumors
records.note: RRM2 overexpression increases cell and tumor growth while knockdown suppresses it; GSH-metabolism genes associate with worse disease-free survival.
records.uncertainty: GSH is endogenous metabolism here, not supplemented glutathione; no drug rescue.

records.title: Centrosome-associated regulators of the G(2)/M checkpoint as targets for cancer therapy.
records.model: Centrosomal G2/M DNA-damage checkpoint in cancer
records.note: Reviews centrosome-associated control of damaged-cell mitotic entry and candidate anticancer targets.
records.uncertainty: No named inhibitor or demonstrated therapeutic checkpoint restoration.

records.title: A single-embryo, single-cell time-resolved model for mouse gastrulation.
records.note: Time-resolved transcription and Foxc1/Foxc2 chimeras support combinatorial lineage multifurcation rather than universally binary fate choices.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic cell-fate intervention.

records.title: Loss of c-Met disrupts gene expression program required for G2/M progression during liver regeneration in mice.

administered_agents.name: EGF
administered_agents.role: continuous in-vitro supplementation of primary hepatocytes

records.model: Hepatocyte-specific Met-knockout mice after partial hepatectomy and cultured hepatocytes
records.note: Met loss blocks G2 progression and delays liver recovery; EGF increases proliferation and partially restores mitotic regulator expression in deficient hepatocyte cultures.
records.uncertainty: EGF rescue was in vitro and incomplete; liver-function rescue in vivo and BUB1B dependence are not shown.

records.title: Clonality and evolutionary history of rhabdomyosarcoma.
records.note: PFN tumors acquire early 11p15.5/RAS events, while PAX-fusion-positive tumors show later whole-genome duplication and fewer subclones.
records.uncertainty: No drug or muscle-compensation treatment.

records.title: LncRNA-mediated regulation of SOX9 expression in basal subtype breast cancer cells.
records.note: linc02095 depletion lowers SOX9 transcription/export and proliferation, while overexpression promotes proliferation through a feedback loop.
records.uncertainty: Gene/RNA perturbation, not an identified administered therapeutic compound.

records.title: Disclosing transcriptomics network-based signatures of glioma heterogeneity using sparse methods.
records.note: Sparse network and clustering analyses distinguish glioblastoma from astrocytoma/oligodendroglioma and nominate literature-supported biomarkers.
records.uncertainty: Molecular validation and treatment testing are explicitly still needed.

records.title: Identification of Key Genes and Prognostic Value Analysis in Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: Hepatocellular cancer expression and survival datasets
records.note: CDK1, CCNB1/2, MAD2L1 and TOP2A emerge as overexpressed hubs associated with poor survival.
records.uncertainty: No drug targeting these hubs is administered.

records.title: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy Achieved Complete Response for Drug-Sensitive EGFR/ALK Mutation-Negative Metastatic Pulmonary Large-Cell Neuroendocrine Carcinoma with High Tumor Mutation Burden: A Case Report.
records.model: High-TMB, PD-L1-negative metastatic pulmonary large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
records.note: One rapidly progressing cancer case achieves complete response to an unnamed immune checkpoint inhibitor, tracked by ctDNA.
records.uncertainty: Agent identity requires source identification; single cancer case does not establish general efficacy or MVA treatment.

records.title: The Promise of Exome Sequencing for the Differential Diagnosis of Late-Onset End-Stage Renal Disease in Turkish Cypriots.
records.model: 24 Turkish Cypriot end-stage renal disease patients
records.note: Renal-gene variant prioritization suggests heterogeneous causes, but prevalent shared variants and missing healthy population data limit etiological conclusions.
records.uncertainty: No renal rescue therapy tested.

records.title: Interaction network analysis of differentially expressed genes and screening of cancer marker in the urine of patients with invasive bladder cancer.
records.model: Invasive bladder cancer and urinary-infection controls
records.note: Urinary BLCA-4/HOXA13 expression discriminates grade with reported 80% sensitivity/specificity after network screening.
records.uncertainty: IGF1 and other names are measured genes, not administered treatment.

records.title: CK1 Is a Druggable Regulator of Microtubule Dynamics and Microtubule-Associated Processes.
records.model: CK1 control of centrosomes and microtubules
records.note: Reviews CK1 phosphorylation of tubulin and associated proteins as a route to modifying microtubule stability in cancer.
records.uncertainty: Candidate drug/peptide identities and directionally beneficial contexts require source identification.

records.title: DNA damage-induced cell death is enhanced by progression through mitosis.
records.model: Transformed cells, human embryonic stem cells and HCT116 tracking
records.note: After DNA damage, 72% of cells exiting mitosis die versus 11% remaining interphase; Z-VAD-FMK only partly suppresses death, which is not explained by polyploidy alone.
records.uncertainty: Blocking death may retain damaged cells; no genomic or tissue restoration demonstrated.

records.title: The large cytoplasmic volume of oocyte.
records.note: Reviews how unusually large oocyte volume is acquired and can adversely affect cell function.
records.uncertainty: No size-modifying drug or demonstrated rescue.

records.title: Crx broadly modulates the pineal transcriptome.
records.note: Crx deletion broadly alters pineal expression and day/night regulation despite preserved morphology, with strong Hoxc4 induction.
records.uncertainty: Transcriptional changes do not establish a functional or drug phenotype.

records.title: Lactate-associated gene MCU promotes the proliferation, migration, and invasion of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
records.note: MCU knockdown suppresses proliferation, invasion, stemness, lactate production and glycolysis after lactate-risk stratification.
records.uncertainty: Lactate is measured metabolism; no administered MCU inhibitor or lactate therapy.

records.title: Biallelic variants in <i>MAD2L1BP</i> (<i>p31<sup>comet</sup></i>) cause female infertility characterized by oocyte maturation arrest.
records.model: Infertile patients' oocytes and mouse oocytes
records.note: Full-length MAD2L1BP cRNA restores polar-body extrusion in patient oocytes with biallelic variants causing metaphase-I arrest; truncations lose MAD2 binding.
records.uncertainty: Endpoint is oocyte maturation, not live birth or chromosome-fidelity proof; distinct from BUB1B and requires primary appraisal.

records.title: Comparison of the latest commercial short and long oligonucleotide microarray technologies.
records.note: One-color platforms show greater reproducibility than the tested two-color platform, with Affymetrix slightly more concordant with matched PCR for small changes.
records.uncertainty: Analytical technology comparison; no intervention candidate.

records.title: An Insight on Multicentric Signaling of Angiotensin II in Cardiovascular system: A Recent Update.

administered_agents.name: angiotensin II
administered_agents.role: reviewed endogenous signaling peptide, not a specified therapeutic administration

records.note: Reviews AT1-receptor cross-talk and potential cardiovascular translation, including stem-cell approaches.
records.uncertainty: No named receptor blocker or measured cardiovascular treatment result.

records.title: Low Cell Number Proteomic Analysis Using In-Cell Protease Digests Reveals a Robust Signature for Cell Cycle State Classification.
records.note: Low-cell proteomics yields a 119-protein cell-cycle signature and identifies timed degradation waves without synchronization.
records.uncertainty: Processing reagents are not drug interventions; signature assignment is not cellular rescue.

records.title: Identification of key gene modules and transcription factors for human osteoarthritis by weighted gene co-expression network analysis.
records.note: OA hub modules link osteoclast, FoxO, MAPK and PI3K/Akt signaling through AP1/MYC-related factors and growth/damage genes.
records.uncertainty: No cartilage-restoring treatment tested.

records.title: From genetics to genomics of epilepsy.
records.note: Reviews transition from targeted mutation diagnosis to genome-wide approaches for familial and sporadic epilepsy.
records.uncertainty: No antiepileptic drug or neuronal rescue result.

records.title: Effectors of the spindle assembly checkpoint are confined within the nucleus of Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
records.note: Checkpoint effectors remain nuclear during closed yeast mitosis, unlike their broad diffusion in mammalian open mitosis.
records.uncertainty: Species-specific localization mechanism; no administered treatment.

records.title: Identification of key pathways and genes in endometrial cancer using bioinformatics analyses.
records.note: BIRC5, CENPF and HJURP overlap expression/miRNA-target predictions and associate with worse survival.
records.uncertainty: RNA-target network is computational, without administered miRNA or drug.

records.title: Tumor-promoting/progressing role of additional chromosome instability in hepatic carcinogenesis in Sgo1 (Shugoshin 1) haploinsufficient mice.
records.note: Azoxymethane drives HCC within six months in chromosome-unstable Sgo1 heterozygotes but not controls; older untreated mutants also develop spontaneous HCC.
records.uncertainty: Models mitotic-error cancer risk; no protective drug tested despite proposed screening utility.

records.title: Bcl-xL phosphorylation at Ser49 by polo kinase 3 during cell cycle progression and checkpoints.
records.model: Cell-cycle/checkpoint assays of Bcl-xL S49 mutants
records.note: Bcl-xL S49A weakens damage-induced G2 arrest and delays post-poison cytokinesis; PLK3-dependent phosphorylation has cell-cycle roles separable from apoptosis.
records.uncertainty: No named inhibitor; inhibiting Bcl-xL cannot be equated with correcting checkpoint defects.

records.title: PRC1, CDCA3, and CDC20 are upregulated and Treg numbers are decreased in canine massive hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: 14 dogs with massive HCC and four normal-liver dogs
records.note: PRC1, CDCA3 and CDC20 rise while inferred Tregs decline in tumors with no observed recurrence/metastasis.
records.uncertainty: Species and subtype differ from human HCC; no drug effect assessed.

records.title: Acentriolar mitosis activates a p53-dependent apoptosis pathway in the mouse embryo.
records.note: Removing p53 rescues apoptosis from acentriolar prometaphase delay, despite normal measured segregation/DNA-damage responses in Sas4 mutants.
records.uncertainty: Apoptosis rescue does not restore centrioles, cilia, Hedgehog response or prove normal development; no p53-inhibiting drug tested.

records.title: Cell-cycle Checkpoints and Aneuploidy on the Path to Cancer.
records.note: Reviews disputed causal directions between aneuploidy and cancer and the contribution of checkpoint mutations to instability.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic intervention or universal claim that aneuploidy clearance is beneficial.

records.title: SSL-VQ: vector-quantized variational autoencoders for semi-supervised prediction of therapeutic targets across diverse diseases.
records.note: SSL-VQ integrates disease and gene-perturbation representations to nominate targets even in poorly characterized diseases.
records.uncertainty: Target prediction performance is not experimental drug validation.

records.title: A Novel Oral Arginase 1/2 Inhibitor Enhances the Antitumor Effect of PD-1 Inhibition in Murine Experimental Gliomas by Altering the Immunosuppressive Environment.
records.model: U87-MG/LN18 invasion assays and GL261 intracranial mouse gliomas
records.note: OAT-1746 crosses the mouse blood-brain barrier, raises brain arginine, blocks microglia-driven invasion without reducing viability and enhances anti-PD-1 tumor control.
records.uncertainty: CNS exposure and tumor control are real but do not show neuronal repair or BUB1B rescue; reference compounds need identification.

records.title: Prognostic roles of mRNA expression of notch receptors in non-small cell lung cancer.
records.note: High Notch1 associates with better survival, Notch2/3 with worse survival in selected subtypes, and Notch4 with no overall association.
records.uncertainty: Receptor-specific associations argue against treating all Notch signaling as one direction; no drug administered.

records.title: Characteristic mutations induced in the small intestine of Msh2-knockout gpt delta mice.

administered_agents.name: potassium bromate
administered_agents.role: 1.5 g/L drinking water for 28 days, oxidative toxicant

records.model: Msh2-knockout gpt reporter mice; small intestine
records.note: Bromate changes mutation hotspots and indel proportions without further raising already elevated total mutant frequency; prior tumor acceleration is contextual evidence.
records.uncertainty: Total mutation count alone misses adverse spectrum changes; no protective intervention.

records.title: MUC1-induced transcriptional programs associated with tumorigenesis predict outcome in breast and lung cancer.
records.model: MUC1 transformation model and breast/lung cancer cohorts
records.note: MUC1 drives oncogenic, angiogenic and matrix programs; its 35-gene signature predicts reduced disease-free and overall survival.
records.uncertainty: No administered MUC1 inhibitor or functional tissue repair.

records.title: Chromosome Segregation Fidelity in Epithelia Requires Tissue Architecture.
records.model: Primary epithelial cells, organoids and polyploid liver
records.note: Native architecture/integrin function improves correction of merotelic attachments; epithelial cells missegregate more outside their tissue context.
records.uncertainty: No named administered integrin modulator; strong warning that culture phenotypes may not represent tissue behavior.

records.title: The role of PLK1 in cancer exhibiting chromosomal instability.
records.note: Reports PLK1 functioning as a tumor suppressor in APC-mutated colorectal cancer through support of checkpoint integrity.
records.uncertainty: Short summary lacks intervention details; contradicts assuming PLK1 inhibition is universally desirable in chromosome-unstable tissue.

records.title: Computational analysis of phosphopeptide binding to the polo-box domain of the mitotic kinase PLK1 using molecular dynamics simulation.
records.model: PLK1 polo-box domain bound to CDC25C phosphopeptide
records.note: Simulations attribute broad substrate recognition to phosphothreonine/backbone contacts and interfacial water energetics.
records.uncertainty: Phosphopeptide is a modeled substrate; no tested small-molecule inhibitor.

records.title: ZNF131 suppresses centrosome fragmentation in glioblastoma stem-like cells through regulation of HAUS5.
records.model: Glioblastoma stem-like cells and neural progenitors
records.note: HAUS5 re-expression rescues ZNF131-knockdown viability; GSCs are more sensitive than progenitors to partial Augmin loss, but combined subunit depletion also kills progenitors.
records.uncertainty: Genetic rescue supports mechanism, not a drug or unlimited neural-cell safety window.

records.title: Identification of Hub Genes in High-Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer Using Weighted Gene Co-Expression Network Analysis.
records.note: MAD2L1/PKD2 and DOCK5/FANCD2/TBRG1 signatures link to prognosis and distinct proliferation/immune programs.
records.uncertainty: Reported DEG totals are inconsistent by one; expression direction versus survival should be checked before target inference.

records.title: Escape from the checkpoint: Nek2A binds a unique conformation of the APC/C-MCC complex.
records.note: Summarizes structural work showing dimeric Nek2A engaging an open APC/C-MCC conformation through MR motifs to escape checkpoint substrate inhibition.
records.uncertainty: Commentary about a primary structural study; no administered compound.

records.title: Interplay between Phosphatases and the Anaphase-Promoting Complex/Cyclosome in Mitosis.
records.note: Reviews reciprocal control between dephosphorylation and selective protein degradation to order mitotic progression.
records.uncertainty: No specific phosphatase drug or rescue result.

records.title: Aurea mediocritas: the importance of a balanced genome.
records.note: Reviews reduced fitness in nontransformed aneuploid cells, adaptation, and genotype-dependent tumor effects, with anticancer targeting discussed.
records.uncertainty: No named aneuploid-selective agent; cancer clearance is not restoration of affected normal tissue.

records.title: The Inherited and Familial Component of Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer.
records.note: Summarizes inherited/familial contributions and broad germline/somatic testing implications for management.
records.uncertainty: No treatment outcome or named drug.

records.title: EB1 acetylation by P300/CBP-associated factor (PCAF) ensures accurate kinetochore-microtubule interactions in mitosis.
records.note: Persistent EB1 K220 acetylation delays alignment and checkpoint silencing; Mad2 suppression overrides arrest without demonstrating corrected attachment.
records.uncertainty: Checkpoint bypass differs from genome rescue; no HDAC inhibitor is named or administered in the abstract.

records.title: Chromosomal instability by mutations in the novel minor spliceosome component CENATAC.
records.model: Constitutional mosaic aneuploidy patients and CENATAC perturbation cells
records.note: Biallelic CENATAC truncations impair AT-AN minor-intron splicing in about 100 genes and cause chromosome-segregation errors.
records.uncertainty: Alternative constitutional-aneuploidy genotype; no BUB1B or pharmacological rescue.

records.title: Septin 7 is required for orderly meiosis in mouse oocytes.
records.note: Both Septin7 depletion and overexpression disrupt meiosis: knockdown impairs spindles/PB1, while excess protein reduces spindle tubulin and impairs PB2 extrusion.
records.uncertainty: More spindle-associated protein is not necessarily beneficial; no small-molecule therapy.

records.title: A homozygous TRIP13 pathogenic variant associated with familiar oocyte arrest and prematurely condensed sperm chromosomes.
records.model: Two infertile sisters, lymphoblasts and yeast pch2 deletion
records.note: Homozygous TRIP13 R173Q associates with oocyte arrest, but both WT and mutant human plasmids complement the yeast recombination assay.
records.uncertainty: Yeast complementation fails to discriminate the pathogenic allele; no drug rescue or broad functional normality follows.

records.title: Prognostic Values of E2F1/2 Transcriptional Expressions in Chromophobe Renal Cell Carcinoma Patients: Evidence from Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.note: E2F1/2 are candidate independent prognostic markers, with E2F family expression, mutations and immune infiltration associated with outcome.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic and clinical validation explicitly remain necessary; no administered agent.

records.title: Clinical Implementation of Matched Tumor/Germline Sequencing Improves Accuracy of Tumor Genomic Profiling and Therapeutic Recommendations.
records.model: Matched cancer/germline sequencing and 1,600 implementation cases
records.note: Matched germline data lower estimated TMB and reclassify 14% of TMB-high cases while retaining actionable inherited variants.
records.uncertainty: Rescuing variants means retaining analytic calls, not therapeutic rescue of cells or patients.

records.title: A kinetochore-based ATM/ATR-independent DNA damage checkpoint maintains genomic integrity in trypanosomes.
records.note: MMS induces KKIP5-dependent metaphase arrest; KKIP5 depletion relieves arrest but increases missegregation and aneuploidy.
records.uncertainty: Parasite-specific checkpoint; removal of arrest is harmful bypass, not repair.

records.title: Development and validation of a prognostic staging system for primary plasma cell leukemia.
records.model: 340 primary plasma-cell leukemia patients plus 80 validation patients
records.note: LDH, thrombocytopenia and selected high-risk cytogenetics stratify survival more accurately than compared models.
records.uncertainty: No treatment-specific response or named drug analyzed in the abstract.

records.title: The fetal brain transcriptome and neonatal behavioral phenotype in the Ts1Cje mouse model of Down syndrome.
records.note: Fetal transcriptome changes accompany neonatal deficits in reflexes, grip, vocalization and homing, motivating earlier therapeutic timing.
records.uncertainty: No prenatal agent administered; rationale for treatment is not rescue evidence.

records.title: Cellular senescence and radiation-induced pulmonary fibrosis.
records.note: Reviews evidence linking radiation senescence to lung fibrosis and potential small-molecule clearance of senescent cells.
records.uncertainty: Identity, functional lung outcomes and tissue replacement after clearance require source identification; not BUB1B restoration.

records.title: High-content imaging and transcriptomic analyses of the effects of bisphenol S and alternative color developers on KGN granulosa cells.

administered_agents.name: bisphenol A (BPA)
administered_agents.role: background replaced chemical, not stated as tested here

records.note: TGSA is most cytotoxic; TGSA/D-8 inhibit cell-cycle, replication and repair pathways, while TGSA/D-8/PF-201 markedly raise lipid droplets despite minimal oxidative-stress changes.
records.uncertainty: Industrial chemicals are exposures, not candidate therapies; similar replacement uses do not ensure similar toxicity.

records.title: PLATE-Seq for genome-wide regulatory network analysis of high-throughput screens.
records.note: Sample barcoding and low-depth pooled sequencing lower profiling cost while retaining network-inferred protein-activity reproducibility.
records.uncertainty: Specific pharmacological screen agents are not named; method paper is not a drug-benefit result.

records.title: The Role of Human Papilloma Virus in Dictating Outcomes in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
records.note: Reviews favorable HPV-positive prognosis, deintensification aims and mutations in recurrent tumors with poor outcomes.
records.uncertainty: No individual drug or deintensified regimen efficacy is established in the abstract.

records.title: Overexpression of Let-7a mitigates diploidization in mouse androgenetic haploid embryonic stem cells.
records.model: Mouse androgenetic haploid embryonic stem cells
records.note: Let-7a/let-7g suppress culture diploidization whereas miR-290a promotes it; let-7a overexpression preserves the haploid tool state.
records.uncertainty: miRNAs are manipulated genes/RNAs with unspecified delivery; haploid maintenance is not rescue of mosaic aneuploid disease.

records.title: Global phosphotyrosinylated protein profile of cell-matrix adhesion complexes of trabecular meshwork cells.
records.note: About 1,000 phosphotyrosine proteins reveal mechanotransduction and overlap with podocyte-filtration machinery.
records.uncertainty: No glaucoma pressure-lowering or renal treatment is tested.

records.title: Polar Chromosomes-Challenges of a Risky Path.
records.note: Reviews why pole-adjacent chromosomes have difficult attachment trajectories and heightened merotelic-error risk despite checkpoint/error correction.
records.uncertainty: No administered congression-restoring agent.

records.title: Universal Germline Testing of Unselected Cancer Patients Detects Pathogenic Variants Missed by Standard Guidelines without Increasing Healthcare Costs.
records.note: Universal 105-gene testing detects pathogenic variants in 15%, many outside existing eligibility criteria, without higher observed one-year care cost.
records.uncertainty: Genetic testing is the intervention; drug outcomes are not reported.

records.title: RNAi screening of the kinome with cytarabine in leukemias.
records.model: Leukemia cell lines and 14 patient-derived samples ex vivo
records.note: WEE1 inhibition sensitizes leukemia to cytarabine up to 97-fold; MK1775 lowers viability in 13/14 patient samples and increases combined apoptosis.
records.uncertainty: Checkpoint inhibition improves malignant-cell killing, not checkpoint repair or normal-tissue safety.

records.title: Multinucleation in the Human Embryo's First Mitosis: Linking Spindle Geometry Defects, SAC Tolerance, Chromosome Segregation, and Nuclear Envelope Reassembly.
records.note: Links abnormal spindle geometry, limited correction time and dispersed chromatin to failed nuclear assembly/multinucleation in large blastomeres.
records.uncertainty: Proposed causal sequence, not a tested fertility intervention.

records.title: Prediction of human disease-related gene clusters by clustering analysis.
records.note: Cluster scoring recovers disease-related modules and highlights tissue-specific versus housekeeping gene composition.
records.uncertainty: Computational gene-cluster recovery does not nominate a demonstrated drug rescue.

records.title: High-throughput methods for identification of protein-protein interactions involving short linear motifs.
records.note: Reviews peptide arrays/display and two-hybrid methods, emphasizing missed context- and modification-dependent interactions.
records.uncertainty: Peptides are profiling reagents, with no named administered candidate.

records.title: Knowledge mapping of AURKA in Oncology：An advanced Bibliometric analysis (1998-2023).
records.note: Maps publication trends, signaling themes and prognostic literature around AURKA.
records.uncertainty: Abstract provides no named therapeutic, intervention effect size or primary drug experiment.

records.title: Discovery of multi-dimensional modules by integrative analysis of cancer genomic data.
records.note: Joint factorization integrates methylation, expression and miRNA to find coordinated modules and clinical subgroups missed by individual modalities.
records.uncertainty: No administered drug or functional validation of target manipulation.

records.title: Inhibition of survivin induces spindle disorganization, chromosome misalignment, and DNA damage during mouse embryo development.
records.note: Survivin inhibition prevents cleavage and causes spindle/chromosome defects, ROS/DNA damage, autophagy and apoptosis.
records.uncertainty: Agent identity is absent; increased autophagy accompanies developmental injury rather than regeneration.

records.title: Prospects for pharmacological targeting of pseudokinases.

administered_agents.name: kinase inhibitors, unspecified
administered_agents.role: reviewed compounds affecting noncatalytic kinase functions

records.note: Reviews structural opportunities for regulating noncatalytic pseudokinases through kinase-like conformations and ligand binding.
records.uncertainty: No specific BUB1B-binding or restoring drug is named; agent identities require source review if pursued.

records.title: Tumor BRCA1, RRM1 and RRM2 mRNA expression levels and clinical response to first-line gemcitabine plus docetaxel in non-small-cell lung cancer patients.

administered_agents.name: paclitaxel
administered_agents.role: background sensitivity association, not the reported trial regimen

records.note: Higher BRCA1 favors gemcitabine/docetaxel response while RRM2 predicts resistance; low BRCA1 instead associates with longer progression time on later cisplatin.
records.uncertainty: Retrospective markers need prospective validation; drug-specific opposing BRCA1 associations are not repair evidence.

records.title: Nontransformed, GM-CSF-dependent macrophage lines are a unique model to study tissue macrophage functions.
records.note: GM-CSF/STAT5-dependent cells self-renew without transformation and resemble alveolar innate responses, producing strong inflammatory signals without IL-10 after selected challenges.
records.uncertainty: Useful culture model, not demonstrated lung regeneration; M. tuberculosis and adenovirus are pathogen challenges.

records.title: Regulation of apoptosis, ferroptosis, and pyroptosis mediated by acetylation.
records.model: Acetylation control of apoptosis, ferroptosis and pyroptosis
records.note: Reviews intersecting acetylation-dependent death pathways and possible cancer/cardiovascular targets.
records.uncertainty: No named acetylation-modifying drug or functional treatment outcome.

records.title: CDK12 phosphorylates 4E-BP1 to enable mTORC1-dependent translation and mitotic genome stability.
records.note: CDK12 cooperates with mTORC1 on 4E-BP1 to translate CHK1 and mitotic/centrosomal mRNAs; deprivation causes alignment, bridging and segregation errors.
records.uncertainty: No named inhibitor tested in the abstract; mTORC1 support here complicates assuming its suppression always helps stability.

records.title: Glucocorticoid signaling and regulatory T cells cooperate to maintain the hair-follicle stem-cell niche.

administered_agents.name: glucocorticoid, unspecified
administered_agents.role: endogenous hormone signal; specific administration not stated

records.model: Skin-resident Tregs and hair-follicle stem cells
records.note: Treg glucocorticoid-receptor loss blocks hair regeneration; GR/Foxp3-induced TGF-beta3 activates HFSC Smad2/3 and proliferation.
records.uncertainty: Hair-regeneration pathway is relevant to tissue function, but supplied hormone/TGF-beta3 rescue and agent identities need source appraisal.

records.title: Whole chromosome loss and associated breakage-fusion-bridge cycles transform mouse tetraploid cells.
records.model: Tetraploid immortalized mouse fibroblasts and immunocompromised mice
records.note: Engineered chromosome loss with breakage-fusion-bridge intermediates impairs adherent growth yet enhances sphere growth and produces tumors in three of four lines.
records.uncertainty: Chromosome loss is confounded with associated BFB damage; lower culture fitness does not ensure lower in-vivo tumor risk.

records.title: A bifunctional kinase-phosphatase module integrates mitotic checkpoint and error-correction signalling to ensure mitotic fidelity
records.note: PLK1-skewed feedback gives strong checkpoint/weak attachments; PP2A-skew gives weak checkpoint/strong attachments and errors. Too many or too few recruited BUB complexes both missegregate.
records.uncertainty: Preprint; any chemical tools are unnamed. Supports balanced regulation rather than indiscriminate PP2A or PLK1 activation.

records.title: Distinct dynein complexes defined by DYNLRB1 and DYNLRB2 regulate mitotic and male meiotic spindle bipolarity.
records.note: DYNLRB2 loss fragments meiotic PCM and arrests metaphase I; its mitotic counterpart DYNLRB1 similarly maintains bipolarity through NuMA and centriole control.
records.uncertainty: Dynein subunits are genetic targets, with no administered rescue.

records.title: The Polyamine-Hypusine Circuit Controls an Oncogenic Translational Program Essential for Malignant Conversion in MYC-Driven Lymphoma.
records.note: Loss of eIF5A hypusination blocks malignant conversion and translation of selected cell-cycle/DNA-replication proteins.
records.uncertainty: Abstract does not specify chemical versus genetic hypusination blockade or polyamine administration; potential inhibitor identity remains unknown.

records.title: The mitotic kinesin KIF11 is a driver of invasion, proliferation, and self-renewal in glioblastoma.

administered_agents.name: KIF11 inhibitor, unspecified
administered_agents.role: administered specific small molecule in cells and orthotopic tumors

records.model: Glioblastoma TIC/non-TIC cells and tumor-bearing mice
records.note: KIF11 inhibition limits growth, invasion, self-renewal and tumor initiation, and prolongs mouse survival.
records.uncertainty: Drug identity requires source identification; survival extension is cancer control, not neural or BUB1B restoration.

records.title: BP-M345, a New Diarylpentanoid with Promising Antimitotic Activity.
records.note: BP-M345 destabilizes microtubules, causes irreversible congression defects and prolonged checkpoint arrest followed by apoptosis.
records.uncertainty: Selective tumor killing is reported without normal-tissue or BUB1B-deficiency rescue evidence.

records.title: Integration of machine learning and experimental validation to identify the prognostic signature related to diverse programmed cell deaths in breast cancer.

administered_agents.name: clofibrate
administered_agents.role: computationally nominated SLC7A5-targeting candidate, not administered

administered_agents.name: imatinib
administered_agents.role: computationally nominated BCL2A1-targeting candidate, not administered

records.model: Breast cancer multiomics datasets and tissue PCR
records.note: A seven-gene cell-death risk score predicts outcome; CMap nominates clofibrate/imatinib and PCR confirms expression of score genes.
records.uncertainty: Drug-target assignments are computational and not experimentally validated by the reported tissue expression work.

records.title: Premature Silencing of the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Is Prevented by the Bub1-H2A-Sgo1-PP2A Axis in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
records.note: Bub1 kinase/H2A-site, Sgo1-binding or PP2A-Rts1 defects allow premature checkpoint silencing despite competent initial activation.
records.uncertainty: Yeast genetic axis, no drug; PP2A effects depend on complex and cellular context.

records.title: Constructing Cell-Specific Causal Networks of Individual Cells for Depicting Dynamical Biological Processes.
records.note: SiCNet constructs cell-specific inferred regulatory networks to improve clustering and nominate dynamic fate regulators.
records.uncertainty: Inferred causality and network scores are not perturbation-confirmed therapeutic effects.

records.title: Functional RNAi Screening Identifies G2/M and Kinetochore Components as Modulators of TNFα/NF-κB Prosurvival Signaling in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
records.note: The saved significance statement says G2/M/kinetochore factors including TTK modulate TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB survival and genotoxicity.
records.uncertainty: UPSTREAM INCOMPLETE: saved text contains only a Significance section, without methods, named drugs or direction-specific results.

records.title: Exploring Molecular Signature and Prognostic Biomarkers in Ovarian Cancer: Insights From Late-Stage, Recurrent, and Metastatic Tumors.
records.model: Recurrent, advanced and metastatic ovarian cancer datasets
records.note: Extracellular-matrix hub genes, especially shared COL1A2, associate with disease state; drug-interaction lookup nominates ocriplasmin and pamidronate.
records.uncertainty: No drug efficacy, target engagement or BUB1B restoration is experimentally demonstrated.

records.title: Whole transcriptome analysis of the effects of type I diabetes on mouse oocytes.
records.note: Diabetic oocytes alter metabolic/developmental programs, with lower Dnmt1 and higher Mbd3 linking metabolic disease to epigenetic disturbance.
records.uncertainty: STZ induces injury model; no glucose-control or oocyte-rescue treatment tested.

records.title: Differential Gene Expression in Human Fibroblasts Simultaneously Exposed to Ionizing Radiation and Simulated Microgravity.
records.note: Simulated microgravity attenuates transcriptional DNA-damage/p53 responses to X-rays or carbon ions, suggesting combined-exposure risk.
records.uncertainty: Physical environmental exposures, not drug intervention; no functional repair outcome.

records.title: Identification of biomarkers in colon cancer based on bioinformatic analysis.
records.model: Colon cancer datasets and cell PCR
records.note: DEPDC1, ECT2, GINS2, HMMR and KIF18A are elevated candidate diagnostic markers after cell-cycle network/survival analysis.
records.uncertainty: No inhibitor treatment or normal-tissue checkpoint benefit.

records.title: Mouse models of colorectal cancer.
records.note: Reviews engineered, chemically induced and inoculated models, stressing that none captures all human CRC characteristics.
records.uncertainty: No specific chemical carcinogen or therapeutic result is stated.

records.title: Kif18a regulates Sirt2-mediated tubulin acetylation for spindle organization during mouse oocyte meiosis.
records.note: Kif18a depletion lowers Sirt2, increases tubulin acetylation and disrupts meiosis; K40R tubulin restores normal spindle morphology.
records.uncertainty: Rescued morphology is narrower than fertility/euploidy; Sirt2 is not administered and niacin dependence is not tested.

records.title: Multiple assembly mechanisms anchor the KMN spindle checkpoint platform at human mitotic kinetochores.
records.note: Near-complete KMN inactivation disables checkpoint signaling even with fully unattached kinetochores; multiple CENP-C/CENP-T assembly routes are delineated.
records.uncertainty: Inactivation methods are not named drugs in the abstract; no therapeutic rescue.

records.title: mRNA expression in papillary and anaplastic thyroid carcinoma: molecular anatomy of a killing switch.
records.note: ATC amplifies PTC-associated programs, with particularly stronger EMT, dedifferentiation and glycolysis; a nine-gene signature separates types.
records.uncertainty: Killing switch is descriptive tumor biology, not administered treatment.

records.title: Female Germ Cell Development in Chickens and Humans: The Chicken Oocyte Enriched Genes Convergent and Divergent with the Human Oocyte.
records.model: Chicken and human female germline development
records.note: Reviews conserved versus species-specific timing and expression during meiotic entry and primordial-follicle formation.
records.uncertainty: No fertility drug or direct maturation rescue.

records.title: Time-Course Transcriptome Analysis of the Lungs of Mice Challenged with Aerosols of Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus USA300 Clone Reveals Inflammatory Balance.
records.note: Inflammation transitions from early IL-17 to interferon/macrophage balance and later proliferative repair with complement/adaptive responses.
records.uncertainty: Recovery follows infection without named therapy; endogenous repair is not an administered cytokine benefit.

records.title: HIV-associated cellular senescence: A contributor to accelerated aging.

administered_agents.name: antiretroviral drugs, unspecified
administered_agents.role: reviewed beneficial HIV treatment with possible senescence-inducing effects

records.note: Antiretroviral therapy enables longer survival, while virus, drugs and substance exposures may induce senescence contributing to comorbidities.
records.uncertainty: Individual antiretroviral or senescence-targeting agents and causal contributions are not supplied.
