records.title: CDC7-dependent transcriptional regulation of RAD54L is essential for tumorigenicity and radio-resistance of glioblastoma.
records.note: CDC7 supports RAD54L transcription/radioresistance; knockdown sensitizes to radiation and an unnamed inhibitor reduces tumor growth in vitro and in vivo.
records.uncertainty: Compound identity and normal repair consequences require source identification; inhibition is not genome restoration.

records.title: Comprehensive Genomic and Transcriptomic Analysis of Three Synchronous Primary Tumours and a Recurrence from a Head and Neck Cancer Patient.
records.model: One head/neck cancer patient with three primaries and recurrence
records.note: Shared mutations trace recurrence origin amid heterogeneous primaries; mutational signatures support alcohol exposure and all tumors appear immunosuppressive.
records.uncertainty: No administered drug or measured treatment response.

records.title: A cis-regulatory lexicon of DNA motif combinations mediating cell-type-specific gene regulation.
records.model: 15 diploid human cell types and cancer cells
records.note: Reporter-validated motif combinations reveal both reuse of normal programs and cancer-specific regulatory combinations.
records.uncertainty: Reporter activity is not therapeutic correction; no administered agent.

records.title: Temporal Effects of Combined Birinapant and Paclitaxel on Pancreatic Cancer Cells Investigated via Large-Scale, Ion-Current-Based Quantitative Proteomics (IonStar).
records.note: Combination suppresses aerobic glycolysis and pro-survival signaling while enhancing G2/M arrest and apoptosis beyond either agent alone.
records.uncertainty: Metabolic normalization accompanies cancer-cell killing, not restored healthy-tissue function or BUB1B activity.

records.title: Tumor analysis: freeze-thawing cycle of triple-negative breast cancer cells alters tumor CD24/CD44 profiles and the percentage of tumor-infiltrating immune cells.
records.model: Fresh versus frozen/thawed TNBC tumor cells
records.note: Freeze-thaw selectively reduces a CD44-low/CD24-low population and changes immune percentages and expression-based clustering.
records.uncertainty: Cryopreservation can distort apparent cell states; no cryoprotectant or therapeutic benefit specified.

records.title: Positively charged specificity site in cyclin B1 is essential for mitotic fidelity.
records.model: HeLa cells and in-vitro APC/C assays
records.note: Cyclin-B1 phosphate-pocket mutation delays anaphase, disrupts spindles and reduces APC/C phosphorylation/ubiquitylation, especially at nonconsensus sites.
records.uncertainty: Structural protein mechanism; no administered stabilizer or drug.

records.title: Molecular tools for the genomic assessment of oocyte's reproductive competence.
records.model: Genomic assessment of human oocyte competence
records.note: Reviews infertility variants and sequencing approaches that extend chromosomal-abnormality assessment to maturation/development genes.
records.uncertainty: Prospective prevention/treatment opportunities, without named therapeutic outcome.

records.title: MicroRNA-regulated protein-protein interaction networks and their functions in breast cancer.
records.model: Breast cancer expression and protein-interaction datasets
records.note: Integrative miRNA-target networks recover known breast-cancer miRNAs and nominate miR-139/383 with putative functions.
records.uncertainty: miRNAs are inferred regulators, not administered mimics or tested rescue agents.

records.title: Interphase APC/C-Cdc20 inhibition by cyclin A2-Cdk2 ensures efficient mitotic entry.
records.note: Preventing Cdc20 phosphorylation prematurely degrades cyclins and delays entry; nondegradable cyclin A2, but not B1, restores entry.
records.uncertainty: Rescues timing through engineered protein expression, without drug or genome-fidelity endpoint.

records.title: Apoptosis induced by piroxicam plus cisplatin combined treatment is triggered by p21 in mesothelioma.

administered_agents.name: piroxicam
administered_agents.role: administered anti-inflammatory drug repurposed in cancer cells

records.note: Piroxicam/cisplatin increases apoptosis through p21, since p21 silencing abolishes the added effect; prior in-vivo survival increase is cited as background.
records.uncertainty: Current abstract supports cell mechanism rather than new clinical survival evidence; not senescence clearance or MVA rescue.

records.title: Topoisomerase IIα in chromosome instability and personalized cancer therapy.

administered_agents.name: topoisomerase inhibitors, unspecified
administered_agents.role: reviewed anticancer drugs with secondary-leukemia concern

records.model: TOP2A, chromosomal instability and cancer therapy
records.note: Reviews decatenation-checkpoint disruption and TOP2A regulation, retaining both anticancer activity and treatment-associated secondary leukemia risk.
records.uncertainty: Individual drugs are unnamed; suppressing replication can damage chromosome integrity.

records.title: Glioblastoma cells have increased capacity to repair radiation-induced DNA damage after migration to the olfactory bulb.
records.model: Human glioblastoma stem-like xenografts in mouse olfactory bulb versus hemisphere
records.note: Olfactory-bulb tumor cells clear damage foci faster, upregulate repair/checkpoint genes and accumulate in G2, suggesting a radioresistant niche.
records.uncertainty: Greater repair protects malignant cells; no administered radioprotective drug or healthy-brain benefit.

records.title: CHFR binds to and regulates MAD2 in the spindle checkpoint through its cysteine-rich domain.
records.note: Removing CHFR's cysteine-rich domain impairs MAD2 localization/CDC20 binding and raises mitotic defects.
records.uncertainty: One sentence says deletion is required for binding, contrary to the surrounding results/conclusion; interpretation follows stated domain requirement.

records.title: Analysis of Cyclin-Dependent Kinase 1 as an Independent Prognostic Factor for Gastric Cancer Based on Statistical Methods.
records.note: High CDK1 associates with advanced stage/grade and reduced survival, with WNT/T-cell pathway enrichment.
records.uncertainty: No administered CDK1 inhibitor and no target-causality test.

records.title: Targeting Lactylation for Cancer: Mechanisms, Effects, and Therapeutic Prospects.

records.uncertainty: No named lactylation inhibitor or functional result in the short abstract.

records.model: Esophageal squamous carcinoma datasets and validation cohorts

records.uncertainty: Ribosome/ITGB1 targeting is proposed; no administered therapy.

records.model: Cell proliferation and multiple tumor types
records.note: Rb-E2F co-regulates p31comet and Mad2; only a narrow antagonist:target ratio supports viability despite their joint tumor elevation.
records.uncertainty: Supports stoichiometric caution, not increasing or decreasing either factor indiscriminately; no drug.

records.uncertainty: Protein overexpression/reconstitution is not a therapeutic expansion strategy.

records.uncertainty: Wording does not clearly specify whether KIF2C expression or knockdown enhances taxane sensitivity; no checkpoint repair.

records.title: Predicting Bone Metastasis Using Gene Expression-Based Machine Learning Models.

records.uncertainty: Background bone-targeting therapies are unnamed; prediction does not establish prevention or repair.

records.title: BUB3, beyond the Simple Role of Partner.
records.model: BUB3 checkpoint, telomere and cancer biology
records.note: Reviews BUB3 deficiency-associated premature aging alongside cancer overexpression/poor prognosis and attachment/telomere functions.
records.uncertainty: BUB3 differs from BUB1B; no administered restoring or anticancer agent in the abstract.

records.title: Bioinformatics analysis of gene expression alterations in microRNA‑122 knockout mice with hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.note: Loss-associated cell-cycle, chemokine and matrix programs nominate NUSAP1, CXCR4, CCR2 and ITGAV as potential miR-122-linked targets.
records.uncertainty: No administered miR-122 mimic or inhibitor tested.

records.title: Molding BRCA2 function through its interacting partners.
records.note: Reviews established/emerging BRCA2 partners and how disrupted functions might explain variant-associated cancer susceptibility.
records.uncertainty: Speculative variant-function links; no administered repair therapy.

records.title: Molecular and genetic regulation of pig pancreatic islet cell development.

records.note: Purified islet profiles reveal human-like maturation and endogenous fetal alpha-cell GLP-1 signaling to beta cells.
records.uncertainty: GLP-1 is endogenous evidence, not an administered agonist or diabetes-rescue experiment.

records.title: Mitochondrial fission genes MTFP1/MTFP2 as predictive biomarkers in prostate cancer: a mendelian randomization study.

records.title: PLK1 Is a Potential Prognostic Factor Associated with the Tumor Microenvironment in Lung Adenocarcinoma.

records.title: Identification and validation of the important role of KIF11 in the development and progression of endometrial cancer.

records.uncertainty: Gene silencing is not evidence for a named drug or restoration of normal chromosome fidelity.

records.title: The balance between mitotic death and mitotic slippage in acute leukemia: a new therapeutic window?

records.title: Identification of key biomarkers associated with development and prognosis in patients with ovarian carcinoma: evidence from bioinformatic analysis.

administered_agents.role: database-listed target therapies, no stated experiment

records.uncertainty: Drug identities and therapeutic effects are absent; other hub targets are speculative.

records.title: Functional impacts of lactylation in Hypoxia‒primed mesenchymal stromal cells.

records.uncertainty: IDO/PGE2/VEGF/HGF are secreted signals, not administered agents; abstract's broad safety claims lack supporting experimental results.

records.title: PARP1-SNAI2 transcription axis drives resistance to PARP inhibitor, Talazoparib.

records.title: Genetic changes associated with relapse in favorable histology Wilms tumor: A Children's Oncology Group AREN03B2 study.

records.title: Cdc20 is required for the post-anaphase, KEN-dependent degradation of centromere protein F.

records.title: Transcriptional profiling of Krüppel-like factor 4 reveals a function in cell cycle regulation and epithelial differentiation.
records.model: Human cell line with inducible KLF4

records.uncertainty: Inducing reagent unnamed; expression-driven growth arrest is not demonstrated senescence reversal.

records.title: Ran-dependent docking of importin-beta to RanBP2/Nup358 filaments is essential for protein import and cell viability.
records.note: A short N-terminal RanBP2 fragment restores nuclear transport and viability after deletion; its Ran-binding domain is essential, while mitotic failure is not apparent.

records.title: Chromosomal instability correlates with poor outcome in patients with myelodysplastic syndromes irrespectively of the cytogenetic risk group.

records.title: Transcriptome analysis of ruminal epithelia revealed potential regulatory mechanisms involved in host adaptation to gradual high fermentable dietary transition in beef cattle.
records.note: Grain transition produces opposite ruminal-pH responses among animals with differing immune, lipid and epithelial-proliferation expression programs.
records.uncertainty: Diet adaptation and candidate SNP association do not demonstrate pharmacological epithelial rescue.

records.title: Deep scSTAR: leveraging deep learning for the extraction and enhancement of phenotype-associated features from single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics data.

records.title: Meta-analysis of gene expression in relapsed childhood B-acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

records.uncertainty: No named intensified chemotherapy or target-specific intervention is evaluated.

records.title: The balance of Polo-like kinase 1 in tumorigenesis.

records.title: PP2A Phosphatase as an Emerging Viral Host Factor.
records.note: Reviews viral hijacking of PP2A, including B56-motif mimicry, for replication, cell-cycle control and oncogenic transformation.

records.title: In silico characterization of competing endogenous RNA network in glioblastoma multiforme with a systems biology approach.
records.note: Integrated lncRNA/miRNA/mRNA profiles nominate ceRNA hubs such as DGCR5, XIST and CRNDE.

records.title: Mitotic chromosome condensation mediated by the retinoblastoma protein is tumor-suppressive.
records.model: pRB chromosome-condensation mutants with Trp53 loss
records.note: Impaired pRB condensation function accelerates loss of heterozygosity and tumor onset/aggression independently of its G1/S role.
records.uncertainty: Genetic mechanism, with no administered rescue.

records.title: Integrative Analysis of Gene Expression Through One-Class Logistic Regression Machine Learning Identifies Stemness Features in Multiple Myeloma.
records.note: High expression-derived stemness predicts worse survival and lower inferred immune/stromal scores; a 34-gene classifier is proposed.
records.uncertainty: No stemness-targeting compound or functional validation of treatment.

records.title: MicroRNAs: key players of taxane resistance and their therapeutic potential in human cancers.

administered_agents.name: taxanes
administered_agents.role: reviewed chemotherapy class, individual agents not named

records.note: Reviews miRNA regulation of cycle, apoptosis, drug transport, EMT and stemness as possible resistance-reversal targets.
records.uncertainty: No specific administered miRNA therapeutic or direct clinical improvement in the abstract.

records.title: Tubulin hyperacetylation drives HMGB1 nuclear exit via the ROS-PARP1 axis, leading to rotenone-induced G2/M arrest.
records.note: PJ34 prevents HMGB1 nuclear exit and rescues rotenone-induced G2/M arrest; alphaTAT1 depletion also limits mtROS and HMGB1 translocation.
records.uncertainty: Cell type and functional neuronal/animal rescue are not stated; Parkinson-related implication and BUB1B relevance remain hypotheses.

records.title: Update on Biology and Genomics of Adrenocortical Carcinomas: Rationale for Emerging Therapies.
records.note: Reviews distinct molecular ACC subtypes and prospective targets while noting frequent metastatic disease refractory to mitotane/chemotherapy and resistance from plasticity.
records.uncertainty: No new targeted drug or therapeutic benefit quantified in the abstract; no MVA rescue.

records.title: No, it is not mutually exclusive! A case report of a girl with two genetic diagnoses: Craniofrontonasal dysplasia and pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 1B.
records.model: Girl with CFND and EXOSC3-related PCH1B
records.note: Whole-exome sequencing explained severe developmental delay beyond the prenatal CFND diagnosis; no treatment was evaluated.
records.uncertainty: Single case; genetic diagnostic lesson rather than BUB1B intervention evidence.

records.title: Dicer is a key player in oocyte maturation.
records.note: Dicer knockdown reduced maturation and spindle/checkpoint transcripts, including the reported Bublb, and increased spindle and chromosome abnormalities.
records.uncertainty: Saved abstract contains ambiguous gene spellings including bulb16; no therapeutic restoration or drug tested.

records.title: Prognostic Alternative mRNA Splicing in Adrenocortical Carcinoma.
records.note: Identifies 1,005 survival-associated splice events and a 12-event predictor, with Wnt enrichment; no administered intervention.
records.uncertainty: Prognostic model does not demonstrate therapeutic benefit.

records.title: Distribution of copy number variations and rearrangement endpoints in human cancers with a review of literature.
records.note: Cancer-specific rearrangement patterns and new endpoint hotspots suggest tissue physiology contributes to CNVs beyond local chromosome architecture.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic agent or chromosome-stability rescue is assessed.

records.title: The SUMO protease SENP6 is essential for inner kinetochore assembly.
records.model: Vertebrate mitotic cells depleted of SENP6
records.note: SENP6 loss destabilizes CENP-H/I/K and disrupts congression; RNF4-mediated CENP-I degradation supplies a kinetochore maintenance mechanism.
records.uncertainty: SENP6 and RNF4 are protein regulators, not administered drugs; pharmacological rescue is not reported.

records.title: Responses of chromosome segregation machinery to mechanical perturbations.
records.model: Mitotic spindles subjected to mechanical forces
records.note: Reviews spindle pliability, size adaptation and mechanochemical responses to controlled physical perturbations.
records.uncertainty: No drug administration or disease rescue is described.

records.title: Clinical Applications of Aneuploidies in Evolution of NSCLC Patients: Current Status and Application Prospect.
records.note: Reviews causes and clinical implications of aneuploidy for tumor evolution, metastasis and drug response without identifying an intervention in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: No named drug or tested strategy for constitutional aneuploidy.

records.title: A comparative analysis of HMGB1 and pCTS-L immunomodulatory properties in human peripheral blood mononuclear cells.
records.note: Both proteins induced cytokine/chemokine programs and NFKB2/RELB; HMGB1 produced broader transcriptional changes and uniquely induced CASP4/5.
records.uncertainty: Inflammation-provoking exposure study; transcriptional changes do not establish therapeutic benefit.

records.title: CompNet: a GUI based tool for comparison of multiple biological interaction networks.
records.model: Host interaction networks after Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection
records.note: CompNet visually compares network intersections, neighborhoods and communities; its infection example infers host-cell fates.
records.uncertainty: Software demonstration, without a drug intervention.

records.title: Old cells, new tricks: chromatin structure in senescence.
records.note: Emphasizes senescence heterogeneity and global, focal and higher-order chromatin alterations.
records.uncertainty: No named therapeutic agent or functional rescue is presented.

records.title: Aldosterone promotes cardiac endothelial cell proliferation in vivo.

administered_agents.name: aldosterone
administered_agents.role: administered hormone for seven days in mice; endothelial stimulation

administered_agents.name: eplerenone
administered_agents.role: administered mineralocorticoid-receptor blocker in heart-failure model

administered_agents.name: sodium chloride
administered_agents.role: background co-exposure associated with aldosterone cardiac injury, not the main experiment

records.model: Mouse heart; human endothelial cells ex vivo; transverse-aortic-constriction heart failure
records.note: Aldosterone increased mainly endothelial cardiac proliferation; eplerenone inhibited endothelial proliferation during pressure-overload heart failure. Proliferation is not evidence of improved cardiac function.
records.uncertainty: Abstract gives no BUB1B measurement or organ-function benefit and does not resolve whether the proliferation is adaptive.

records.title: IK-guided PP2A suppresses Aurora B activity in the interphase of tumor cells.

administered_agents.name: unnamed Aurora B inhibitor
administered_agents.role: experimental inhibition converting IK-depletion mitotic arrest into G2 arrest

records.model: Tumor cells during interphase and mitosis
records.note: IK recruits PP2A to restrain Aurora B before mitosis; Aurora B inhibition changes the arrest produced by IK depletion.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor identity and dosing absent; arrest transition does not demonstrate chromosome rescue.

records.title: miR-210 Regulates Apoptotic Cell Death during Cellular Hypoxia and Reoxygenation in a Diametrically Opposite Manner.
records.model: AC-16 cardiomyocytes exposed to hypoxia then reoxygenation
records.note: miR-210 reduced intrinsic apoptosis during hypoxia but increased caspase-8-mediated extrinsic apoptosis on reoxygenation, making timing central to benefit versus harm.
records.uncertainty: Cell survival mechanism in a cardiac line; no administered small molecule or BUB1B model.

records.title: Comprehensive Transcriptome Analysis of mRNA Expression Patterns Associated With Enhanced Biological Functions in Periodontal Ligament Stem Cells Subjected to Short-Term Hypoxia Pretreatment.
records.model: Healthy and inflammatory periodontal-ligament stem cells
records.note: Short hypoxia pretreatment changed glycolytic, differentiation and immune programs; inflammatory cells showed stronger cell-cycle enrichment and healthy cells TGF-beta enrichment.
records.uncertainty: Study emphasizes transcriptomic mechanisms; the abstract does not quantify tissue regeneration in this experiment.

records.title: Identification of novel candidate genes and small molecule drugs in ovarian cancer by bioinformatics strategy.
records.model: Ovarian-cancer expression datasets and tissue validation
records.note: Six overexpressed prognostic hub genes and NCAPG tissue validation accompany unnamed CMap candidate compounds.
records.uncertainty: Drug names absent from the saved abstract; predictions do not establish efficacy or BUB1B restoration.

records.title: SIRT6 Maintains Redox Homeostasis to Promote Porcine Oocyte Maturation.
records.note: SIRT6 inhibition impaired polar-body extrusion, spindle/chromosome and actin organization, and cortical-granule maturation; excessive ROS and early apoptosis were implicated.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor identity absent; results support SIRT6 maintenance but do not test an activator or niacin rescue.

records.title: RETRACTED: Expression of microRNAs and their target genes in melanomas originating from gynecologic sites.
records.note: Reports site-dependent miRNA profiles, TOP2A upregulation and inverse miRNA correlations with SOCS3/CDKN1A; title explicitly marks the publication retracted.
records.uncertainty: Retracted source; retain only as an unreliable catalog record, not treatment evidence.

records.title: Cancer-risk module identification and module-based disease risk evaluation: a case study on lung cancer.
records.note: A coexpression method identified 31 lung-cancer risk modules and outperformed WGCNA in disease-risk classification across eight datasets.
records.uncertainty: No treatment or drug testing.

records.title: Inhibition of Hec1 expression enhances the sensitivity of human ovarian cancer cells to paclitaxel.
records.model: Ovarian cancer lines, especially paclitaxel-resistant A2780/Taxol
records.note: Hec1 depletion reduced paclitaxel IC50 from about 590 to 46 nM in resistant cells with increased apoptotic markers; parental A2780 sensitivity did not change.
records.uncertainty: Selective cancer-cell killing after kinetochore impairment is not repair of BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: Genetic analysis of the spindle checkpoint genes san-1, mdf-2, bub-3 and the CENP-F homologues hcp-1 and hcp-2 in Caenorhabditis elegans.

administered_agents.name: hcp-1, hcp-2, mdf-1, mdf-2 and bub-3 RNAi

records.note: HCP-1, MAD1/2 or BUB3 depletion worsened san-1-mutant viability; HCP-2 was less consequential, and san-1/BUB3 loss increased anoxia sensitivity.
records.uncertainty: Checkpoint interaction genetics; no pharmacological rescue.

records.title: Genome-Wide Re-Sequencing Data Reveals the Population Structure and Selection Signatures of Tunchang Pigs in China.
records.model: Tunchang and seven other pig breeds
records.note: Population resequencing found selection regions linked to meat quality, immunity, growth and metabolism, with greater diversity than commercial breeds.
records.uncertainty: Breeding associations contain no administered drug or disease rescue.

records.title: Temporal Transcriptome Dynamics of Longissimus dorsi Reveals the Mechanism of the Differences in Muscle Development and IMF Deposition between Fuqing Goats and Nubian Goats.
records.model: Developing Fuqing versus Nubian goat skeletal muscle
records.note: Growth and intramuscular fat differences track embryonic cell-cycle, neonatal ribosomal and later glucose/lipid metabolic programs.
records.uncertainty: Observational breed comparison, not myostatin treatment or BUB1B restoration.

records.title: Niacin in pharmacological doses alters microRNA expression in skeletal muscle of obese Zucker rats.

administered_agents.name: niacin
administered_agents.role: 780 versus 30 mg supplemental niacin/kg diet for four weeks

records.note: High-dose niacin changed 42 of 259 measured miRNAs; predicted targets implicated transcriptional regulation, Wnt and MAPK as explanations for prior muscle phenotype observations.
records.uncertainty: Current abstract does not measure BUB1B restoration, strength or MVA rescue; target interactions are computational predictions.

records.title: Transcriptome analyses identify hub genes and potential mechanisms in adenoid cystic carcinoma.
records.model: 15 adenoid cystic carcinomas and seven normal salivary tissues
records.note: A seven-gene overexpressed hub set including CDK1 and TOP2A was linked to poor survival, with extracellular-matrix and p53 pathway enrichment.
records.uncertainty: No compound or therapeutic effect tested.

records.title: Single-Nucleotide Polymorphisms Promote Dysregulation Activation by Essential Gene Mediated Bio-Molecular Interaction in Breast Cancer.
records.note: Identifies 42 risk modules and 16 bridging biomarkers, with CYP24A1 RNA structural variation and elevated ABHD11-AS1.
records.uncertainty: Drug targets are integrated computationally but no named administered drug or efficacy is reported.

records.title: Key genes and regulatory networks involved in the initiation, progression and invasion of colorectal cancer.
records.note: Network analysis nominates CDK1, UBC, ESR1 and ATXN1 with Wnt, MAPK and JAK-STAT pathways; unspecified findings receive in-vitro confirmation.
records.uncertainty: No named drug or specific therapeutic response in abstract.

records.title: Analysis of hepatic transcript profile and plasma lipid profile in early lactating dairy cows fed grape seed and grape marc meal extract.

administered_agents.name: grape seed and grape marc meal extract (GSGME)

records.note: GSGME suppressed hepatic ER-stress/UPR and inflammatory transcripts and lowered plasma SAA and haptoglobin; lipid species did not change. Increased milk yield was reported in prior work.
records.uncertainty: Mixture composition and doses absent; this study supplies stress/inflammation markers rather than proof of liver functional rescue or BUB1B modulation.

records.title: Comprehensive analysis of potential prognostic genes for the construction of a competing endogenous RNA regulatory network in hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.note: Builds a ceRNA network around 13 prognostic genes, including CHEK1, RRM2 and SLC7A11, with nine survival-associated lncRNAs.
records.uncertainty: Regulatory predictions and survival associations provide no administered intervention.

records.title: Organization and Evolution of Drosophila Terminin: Similarities and Differences between Drosophila and Human Telomeres.
records.note: Proposes rapidly evolved fly terminin as a functional shelterin analogue and distinguishes conserved non-terminin telomere-protection proteins.
records.uncertainty: Evolutionary telomere biology; no drug testing.

records.title: Long noncoding RNA LINC00858 aggravates the progression of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma via regulating the miR-425-5p/ABL2 axis.
records.note: LINC00858 suppression restrained proliferation, migration and EMT; ABL2 knockdown reversed the promoting effect of miR-425-5p inhibition.
records.uncertainty: LINC00858 and ABL2 are genetic targets; no named therapeutic drug or BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Acquisition of an oncogenic fusion protein serves as an initial driving mutation by inducing aneuploidy and overriding proliferative defects.
records.note: The fusion oncogene rewired chromosome-maintenance and growth-factor RNA programs, both inducing aneuploidy and bypassing its growth arrest; phosphorylation contributed.
records.uncertainty: Overcoming aneuploid growth arrest here promotes cancer and should not be counted as healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Chromosome instability in colorectal tumor cells is associated with defects in microtubule plus-end attachments caused by a dominant mutation in APC.
records.note: A single truncating APC allele dominantly impaired microtubule plus-end attachments and metaphase alignment, explaining one route to CIN.
records.uncertainty: APC mutation study, without an administered rescue agent.

records.title: Case report: HER2 amplification as a resistance mechanism to crizotinib in NSCLC with MET exon 14 skipping.
records.model: NSCLC patient with MET exon-14 skipping
records.note: Crizotinib produced clinical and imaging remission before progression accompanied by HER2 and other gene amplifications; the patient ultimately died of cancer.
records.uncertainty: Single cancer case; bypass resistance, not chromosome-stability restoration.

records.title: Cohesin controls intestinal stem cell identity by maintaining association of Escargot with target promoters.
records.note: Rad21 or Nipped-B depletion induced premature enterocyte differentiation; escargot overexpression rescued this independently of Notch, linking cohesin to stem-cell identity.
records.uncertainty: A tissue-homeostasis rescue by gene expression, without pharmacological or BUB1B testing.

records.title: A gene expression signature shared by human mature oocytes and embryonic stem cells.
records.model: Human mature oocytes, embryonic stem cells and somatic tissues
records.note: A shared pluripotency-associated program included proteasome genes; embryonic stem cells were selectively sensitive to proteasome inhibition as pathway expression fell during differentiation.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor identity and sensitivity endpoint absent; no therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Identification of NCAPG as an Essential Gene for Neuroblastoma Employing CRISPR-Cas9 Screening Database and Experimental Verification.
records.note: NCAPG knockdown impaired growth and invasion, caused G2/S arrest and activated p53-associated apoptosis; a NCAPG/MAD2L1 prognostic signature was developed.
records.uncertainty: CRISPR screening and gene suppression, not a named administered drug.

records.title: Congenital Malignant Ectomesenchymoma Presenting as a Neck Mass in a Newborn.

administered_agents.name: vincristine
administered_agents.role: administered in VAC and VIT chemotherapy

administered_agents.name: irinotecan
administered_agents.role: administered after recurrence in VIT chemotherapy

administered_agents.name: temozolomide
administered_agents.role: administered after recurrence in VIT chemotherapy

records.model: Newborn with congenital neck malignant ectomesenchymoma
records.note: After surgical resection, tumor recurred at week nine of VAC, prompting VIT; the abstract does not give a subsequent VIT response.
records.uncertainty: Rare tumor case with no BUB1B genotype or constitutional rescue evidence; later treatment outcome missing.

records.title: Construction of novel lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA ceRNA networks associated with prognosis of hepatitis C virus related hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.note: Expression-network analyses nominated prognostic RNAs and experimentally supported a BUB1/miR-193a-3p/MALAT1 relationship.
records.uncertainty: BUB1 is distinct from BUB1B; no named therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Experimental and clinical evidence suggests that GRPEL2 plays an oncogenic role in HCC development.
records.note: GRPEL2 depletion inhibited growth and invasion and increased ROS, mitochondrial membrane potential and apoptosis; cell-cycle and NF-kappaB pathways were implicated.
records.uncertainty: Mitochondrial perturbation kills cancer cells; no drug or tissue-rescue claim.

records.title: A Pilot Epigenome-Wide Study of Posttraumatic Growth: Identifying Novel Candidates for Future Research.
records.model: 39 trauma-exposed paramedicine students plus replication sample
records.note: Posttraumatic growth associated with methylation at PCDHA/PDZD sites and selected PTSD-related genes, with ABC-transporter pathway enrichment.
records.uncertainty: Small observational study; no drug administration or causal intervention.

records.title: Identifying candidate agents for lung adenocarcinoma by walking the human interactome.

administered_agents.name: atracurium
administered_agents.role: administered candidate anticancer drug in A549 cells

administered_agents.name: hesperidin
administered_agents.role: previously reported lung-cancer agent mentioned as ranking context

records.note: Atracurium induced cell death, increased Bad/Bax and caspase-3 activity, and reduced Bcl-2, p-Bad, p53 and p21 after computational nomination.
records.uncertainty: In-vitro cancer cytotoxicity; dose, therapeutic window and in-vivo benefit absent, with no BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Quantitative proteomics reveals the basis for the biochemical specificity of the cell-cycle machinery.
records.model: Mammalian cyclin E1/A2/B1 interaction networks across the cell cycle
records.note: Time-resolved proteomics identifies stage-specific cyclin interactions and Wee1/Sld3 substrates explaining cyclin-A control of replication and mitosis.
records.uncertainty: Protein interaction analysis without a pharmacological intervention.

records.title: Transcriptome analysis indicates improved adipose tissue function in growing Iberian pig fed olive by-products based diets.

administered_agents.name: wet crude olive cake
administered_agents.role: administered feed and ad-libitum silage component

records.model: 15 growing Iberian pigs, backfat after 191 days
records.note: Both olive diets suppressed predicted inflammatory/immune and ROS functions; wet crude cake also activated apoptosis/cell-death programs and suppressed lipid/cholesterol metabolism.
records.uncertainty: Transcriptome-derived functional predictions in five pigs per arm; improved adipose function was inferred rather than directly established.

records.title: Discovery of novel DNA methylation biomarkers for non-invasive sporadic breast cancer detection in the Latino population.
records.model: Uruguayan breast-cancer patients and healthy controls
records.note: A 38-CpG leukocyte panel separated cases and controls and matched tumor differences; independent validation nominated CYFIP1 methylation.
records.uncertainty: Diagnostic proof of concept without treatment.

records.title: ASYMMETRIC LEAVES1 and REVOLUTA are the key regulatory genes associated with pitcher development in Nepenthes khasiana.
records.note: Leaf-tip AS1 and REV expression accompanies early pitcher formation and suggests roles in tendril formation and altered leaf polarity.
records.uncertainty: Plant developmental study with no administered therapeutic agent.

records.title: Drosophila Xpd regulates Cdk7 localization, mitotic kinase activity, spindle dynamics, and chromosome segregation.
records.note: Xpd loss mislocalized Cdk7/CAK, produced cross-spindle chromosome attachments, multipolarity and aneuploidy independently of transcription or nucleotide-excision repair.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacological correction; mechanistic relevance to spindle fidelity only.

records.title: FoxM1 repression during human aging leads to mitotic decline and aneuploidy-driven full senescence.
records.model: Aged human dermal fibroblasts and Hutchinson-Gilford progeria fibroblasts
records.note: FoxM1 induction prevented aneuploidy and ameliorated cellular aging phenotypes; live imaging linked age-related mitotic decline and early SASP to FoxM1 repression.
records.uncertainty: Concrete cell-level mitotic rescue, but induction method, tissue function, cancer tradeoffs and BUB1B-deficient applicability require primary appraisal.

records.title: Gene Expression Profiling of the Sciatic Nerve in Streptozotocin-Induced Diabetic Rats with Peripheral Neuropathy.
records.model: Rat diabetic peripheral neuropathy and sciatic nerve
records.note: STZ-induced diabetes reduced withdrawal thresholds and motor conduction and altered sciatic-nerve histology; subsequent profiling nominated Cdk1, complement and metabolic hubs.
records.uncertainty: Drug induces neuropathy; no treatment response or nerve rescue was tested.

records.title: Identification of pathogenic genes of pterygium based on the Gene Expression Omnibus database.
records.note: Pterygium profiling identified FN1, BUB3 and other network hubs; selected extracellular-matrix and epithelial transcripts were validated by qPCR.
records.uncertainty: Candidate targets only, without treatment response.

records.title: A Molecular Perspective and Role of NAD<sup>+</sup> in Ovarian Aging.

administered_agents.name: NAD+
administered_agents.role: reviewed endogenous coenzyme, not administered in this review

records.note: Reviews NAD+ consumption by sirtuins, PARPs and CD38 and its possible connection to reproductive aging.
records.uncertainty: No named precursor regimen or measured fertility rescue in abstract; NAD+ biology does not establish niacin efficacy in MVA.

records.title: ASPP1/2-PP1 complexes are required for chromosome segregation and kinetochore-microtubule attachments.
records.note: ASPP1/2 recruit PP1 to Hec1 for Ser165 dephosphorylation; their loss causes unaligned chromosomes, low kinetochore tension and persistent checkpoint activation.
records.uncertainty: Protein-targeting mechanism, without a drug intervention.

records.title: Transcriptional co-activators: emerging roles in signaling pathways and potential therapeutic targets for diseases.
records.model: Transcriptional co-activators across cancer and other diseases
records.note: Discusses indirect targeting of transcription factors through co-activators and the potential for context-specific therapeutic effects.
records.uncertainty: No drug names, outcomes or BUB1B-specific intervention in the abstract.

records.title: Cyclin B3 and dynein heavy chain cooperate to increase fitness in the absence of mdf-1/MAD1 in Caenorhabditis elegans.
records.model: C. elegans lacking mdf-1/MAD1 over 470 generations
records.note: Cyclin-B3 amplification and a dynein-heavy-chain missense mutation cooperatively improve fitness and suppress sterility without delaying anaphase onset.
records.uncertainty: Checkpoint-defect compensation is demonstrated genetically in worms; no drug or human BUB1B equivalence established.

records.title: ANRIL regulates multiple molecules of pathogenetic significance in diabetic nephropathy.
records.model: Diabetic ANRIL-knockout and wild-type mouse kidneys
records.note: ANRIL knockout corrected albuminuria and polyuria and prevented broad diabetic transcript changes involving ECM, apoptosis, NF-kappaB and AGE-RAGE.
records.uncertainty: Renal functional benefit is from genetic deletion; no ANRIL drug or BUB1B-deficient model tested.

records.title: Mass spectrometry-based proteomic platforms for better understanding of SARS-CoV-2 induced pathogenesis and potential diagnostic approaches.
records.model: SARS-CoV-2 infected cell lines and tissues
records.note: Cross-compares proteomic platforms and highlights EPHA2 across 11 studies while warning that cell lines incompletely capture tissue responses.
records.uncertainty: No named therapeutic administration or measured clinical benefit.

records.title: Parental genome unification is highly error-prone in mammalian embryos.
records.note: Parental chromosomes polarize and cluster at the pronuclear interface through centrosomes, dynein, microtubules and nuclear pores; failed clustering causes segregation errors and micronuclei.
records.uncertainty: No named drug or clinical embryo-rescue intervention in abstract.

records.title: Identifying the HIV-Resistance-Related Factors and Regulatory Network via Multi-Omics Analyses.
records.model: HIV-related transcriptome, methylation, miRNA and ChIP datasets
records.note: Integrates resistance-associated genes and networks, nominating JUN, EGF and PLEK alongside previously validated host-dependency/restriction factors.
records.uncertainty: Predicted targets rather than administered antiviral agents.

records.title: The lactylation modification of proteins plays a critical role in tumor progression.
records.note: Reviews lactylation in angiogenesis, immune polarization and resistance, proposing future targets without identifying a tested compound in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: No administration, dosing or treatment outcome provided.

records.title: Key regulatory genes and signaling pathways involved in islet culture: a bioinformatic analysis.
records.note: Islet culture changes FN1, MKI67, IGF1, MAPK14 and COL1A1-associated programs, with TGF-beta, MAPK and VEGF enrichment.
records.uncertainty: Survival improvement is a motivation, not an intervention outcome; expression/methylation terminology is inconsistent.

records.title: The Consequences of Chromosome Segregation Errors in Mitosis and Meiosis.
records.note: Reviews harmful gene-dosage changes, reproductive defects and tumor/pathogen drug resistance, while recognizing context-dependent adaptation to aneuploidy.
records.uncertainty: No named therapeutic drug or restoration experiment.

records.title: Gene expression profiling of mouse p53-deficient epidermal carcinoma defines molecular determinants of human cancer malignancy.
records.model: p53-deficient mouse epidermal carcinomas and human cancer cohorts
records.note: p53 loss, accelerated by Rb loss, produced aggressive tumors with CIN/stem-cell signatures; a 20-gene signature predicted poor human cancer outcomes.
records.uncertainty: Models and biomarkers, without an administered treatment.

records.title: Pathogenic mechanisms of lung adenocarcinoma in smokers and non-smokers determined by gene expression interrogation.
records.model: Early lung adenocarcinoma in smokers and never-smokers
records.note: Both groups shared extracellular-matrix changes, while smoking-associated tumors uniquely upregulated cell-cycle regulators and altered p53 networks.
records.uncertainty: Smoking exposure comparison is not a therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Leveraging gene correlations in single cell transcriptomic data.
records.model: Simulated scRNAseq and clonal melanoma cells
records.note: BigSur models unnormalized read noise to identify weak gene correlations and biologically coherent gene communities.
records.uncertainty: Statistical method, without drug testing.

records.title: RZZ and Mad1 dynamics in Drosophila mitosis.
records.note: About 40% of kinetochore Mad1 turns over with a 12-second half-life while RZZ is stable; co-immunoprecipitation supports physical association.
records.uncertainty: Reporter-dynamics experiment without disease rescue.

records.title: Identification of a Novel Candidate Gene for Serrated Polyposis Syndrome Germline Predisposition by Performing Linkage Analysis Combined With Whole-Exome Sequencing.
records.note: Linkage plus exome sequencing nominated several segregating genes, with network analysis favoring FBLN2 for germline predisposition.
records.uncertainty: No intervention; candidate-gene inference and an unusual reported P-value inequality need caution.

records.title: Down-regulation of the Lamin A/C in neuroblastoma triggers the expansion of tumor initiating cells.

administered_agents.name: retinoic acid
administered_agents.role: previously tested differentiation agent whose effect was blocked by lamin A/C loss

records.note: Lamin A/C knockdown expands self-renewing tumor-initiating cells through increased MYCN; prior work showed resistance to retinoic-acid differentiation.
records.uncertainty: Current abstract focuses on genetic tumor promotion and gives no drug dosing or restoration.

records.title: Use of the protein ontology for multi-faceted analysis of biological processes: a case study of the spindle checkpoint.
records.note: Protein Ontology resolves modification-specific forms and complexes to examine phosphorylation and kinetochore interactions.
records.uncertainty: Knowledge representation, not treatment testing.

records.title: Aneuploidy affects proliferation and spontaneous immortalization in mammalian cells.
records.model: Primary mouse lines trisomic for four different chromosomes
records.note: Each trisomy impaired proliferation and altered metabolism, while immortalization depended on the extra chromosome.
records.uncertainty: No intervention; baseline fitness costs cannot identify a restorative drug.

records.title: AURKB as a key driver of esophageal cancer progression: Molecular mechanisms and potential nursing implications based on multi-omics analysis.
records.note: AURKB emerged among four core genes with high tumor expression and immune heterogeneity; the abstract attributes cell-cycle and ferroptosis-resistance roles.
records.uncertainty: Described methods are largely database analyses; causal driver language exceeds demonstrated intervention evidence.

records.title: Genome-wide mapping and analysis of active promoters in mouse embryonic stem cells and adult organs.
records.model: Mouse embryonic stem cells and adult organs
records.note: Maps roughly 24,000 promoters and 4,396 tissue-specific sites, distinguishing CpG-linked broad activity from tissue-dependent promoters.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or functional rescue.

records.title: De novo pathogenic variants in CHAMP1 are associated with global developmental delay, intellectual disability, and dysmorphic facial features.
records.model: Five individuals with de novo CHAMP1 variants
records.note: Loss-of-function CHAMP1 variants accompany developmental delay, intellectual disability and often microcephaly, consistent with chromosome-alignment involvement.
records.uncertainty: Related kinetochore disorder, without drug or BUB1B treatment evidence.

records.title: EARN: an ensemble machine learning algorithm to predict driver genes in metastatic breast cancer.
records.model: 450 metastatic breast tumors and primary-tumor comparison
records.note: EARN combines three classifiers to nominate metastatic-cancer driver panels including HDAC3, SIRT4 and KRAS.
records.uncertainty: High classifier performance does not establish treatment efficacy; no administered drugs.

records.title: Mapping the assembly pathways that specify formation of the trilaminar kinetochore plates in human cells.
records.model: Human centromere-kinetochore complexes, including HeLa cells
records.note: CENP-A supports three assembly pathways; CENP-I/NUF2 governs plate formation and only about 10% of HeLa CENP-A suffices for normal protein recruitment.
records.uncertainty: Protein assembly study without a therapeutic intervention.

records.title: [Bioinformatic analysis of direct protein targets of aspirin against human breast cancer proliferation].

administered_agents.name: aspirin
administered_agents.role: administered to breast-cancer cells for protein-expression validation

records.note: Aspirin reduced CDC25C, TPX2, CDC20 and PLK1 proteins after network nomination as cell-cycle targets.
records.uncertainty: Protein downregulation rather than direct target binding or BUB1B restoration; no functional normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: Integrated analysis of cell cycle and p53 signaling pathways related genes in breast, colorectal, lung, and pancreatic cancers: implications for prognosis and drug sensitivity for therapeutic potential.

administered_agents.name: unnamed database drugs
administered_agents.role: predicted gene-drug sensitivity interactions, not administered

records.model: Breast, colorectal, lung and pancreatic cancer datasets
records.note: Common cell-cycle/p53 hubs include prognostic MCM4/6, CCNA2, CDC20 and CHEK1, accompanied by unnamed drug-sensitivity relationships.
records.uncertainty: Drug names and experimental effects absent; source identification needed for enumeration.

records.title: In Silico Discovery of 5'-Modified 7-Deoxy-7-ethynyl-4'-thioadenosine as a HASPIN Inhibitor and Its Synergistic Anticancer Effect with the PLK1 Inhibitor.

administered_agents.name: cytotoxic 4'-thioadenosine analogue
administered_agents.role: genotoxic starting scaffold for compound development

records.model: Lung-cancer cells and in-vivo tumor model; noncancer-cell comparison

records.title: A Pathway-Based Strategy to Identify Biomarkers for Lung Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis.
records.model: 13 lung-cancer expression studies and independent cohorts
records.note: Pathway integration yielded a 32-gene adenocarcinoma classifier and a 43-gene outcome signature independent of traditional clinical indicators.
records.uncertainty: No treatment intervention.

records.title: Germline mutations in the PAF1 complex gene CTR9 predispose to Wilms tumour.
records.note: Inactivating CTR9 variants segregated in three families, with second hits in available tumors, supporting a PAF1-complex tumor-suppressor role.
records.uncertainty: Predisposition genetics, without drug testing.

records.title: Dysregulation of Pseudogenes/lncRNA-Hsa-miR-1-3p-PAICS Pathway Promotes the Development of NSCLC.
records.note: Nominates miR-1-3p/PAICS and upstream pseudogene/lncRNA regulators after finding elevated CCNB1, CDK1 and PAICS.
records.uncertainty: Claims of effective treatment are not supported by an administered intervention in abstract.

records.title: Phase transition of spindle-associated protein regulate spindle apparatus assembly.
records.model: BuGZ in Xenopus egg extracts and mammalian cells
records.note: Temperature-dependent BuGZ coacervation and tubulin/microtubule binding concentrate spindle building blocks; hydrophobic residues are necessary.
records.uncertainty: Phase-separation mechanism, without drug treatment or BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Intratumoral microbiota is associated with prognosis in patients with adrenocortical carcinoma.
records.note: Intratumoral bacteria were supported by 16S/LPS staining; microbial clusters tracked survival and cell-cycle/p53 expression programs.
records.uncertainty: No antibiotic or microbiome manipulation tested.

records.title: The final link: tapping the power of chemical genetics to connect the molecular and biologic functions of mitotic protein kinases.

administered_agents.name: unnamed analog-sensitive kinase inhibitors
administered_agents.role: reviewed research tools, not administered by review

records.note: Reviews engineered kinase alleles, proteomics and chemical complementation for linking mitotic functions to specific phosphorylation events.
records.uncertainty: No compound identity or therapeutic efficacy in abstract.

records.title: Genes' Interactions: A Major Contributor to the Malignant Transformation of Endometriosis.
records.note: Surveys recent gene interaction, eQTL and network evidence and emphasizes sampling limitations for rare malignant transformation.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Identification of Y-box binding protein 1 as a core regulator of MEK/ERK pathway-dependent gene signatures in colorectal cancer cells.

administered_agents.name: unnamed RTK/RAS/MAPK-pathway inhibitors
administered_agents.role: administered to colorectal-cancer cells for transcriptional profiling

records.model: Colorectal-cancer cells and patient gene signatures
records.note: Pathway inhibition identifies shared proliferation genes and validates YBX1 as a regulator of MEK/ERK-responsive signatures linked to poor prognosis.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor names absent; response is not BUB1B restoration.

records.title: Aurora B kinase activity is regulated by SET/TAF1 on Sgo2 at the inner centromere.
records.model: Mitotic cells with altered centromeric SET/TAF1
records.note: Sgo2-recruited SET inhibits PP2A to preserve Aurora-B error correction, but SET overexpression disrupts attachments and induces CIN.
records.uncertainty: Balanced regulation matters; simply increasing a checkpoint-associated regulator can be harmful, and no drug tested.

records.title: RNA-Seq Bayesian Network Exploration of Immune System in Bovine.
records.note: Bayesian analysis nominates TERF2IP, PDCD10, DDX10 and CENPE as stress-regulatory nodes with human-orthologue comparison.
records.uncertainty: No drug exposure identified or stress rescue demonstrated; network-connectivity descriptions conflict.

records.title: PRR11 promotes cell proliferation by regulating PTTG1 through interacting with E2F1 transcription factor in pan-cancer.
records.model: Three cancer-cell lines and pan-cancer cohorts
records.note: PRR11 suppression inhibits proliferation/migration and lowers PTTG1; nuclear PRR11 recruits E2F1 to the PTTG1 promoter to drive cell-cycle progression.
records.uncertainty: No administered drug; abstract ambiguously describes cell-line S-phase experiments as in vivo.

records.title: Orderly inactivation of the key checkpoint protein mitotic arrest deficient 2 (MAD2) during mitotic progression.
records.note: Free MCC-associated MAD2 disassembles before APC/C-bound MAD2; the latter requires proteasomal activity and CDC20 degradation.
records.uncertainty: No inhibitor identity or therapeutic result is provided; mechanism only.

records.title: Coupling to short linear motifs creates versatile PME-1 activities in PP2A holoenzyme demethylation and inhibition.
records.note: PME-1 uses substrate-mimicking motifs to block PP2A substrate recognition and demethylate holoenzymes; B56-interface mutations isolate p53-related functions.
records.uncertainty: Proteins and mutations are not drugs; no pharmacological rescue.

records.title: The Personalized Inherited Signature Predisposing to Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer in Non-Smokers.
records.model: Never-smoking early-onset NSCLC patients and unaffected siblings
records.note: Combined exome/RNA analysis nominates private sets of four to eight functionally supported cancer-predisposition variants per patient.
records.uncertainty: Personalized therapy is a proposal; none is administered or evaluated.

records.title: DNA damage activates the SAC in an ATM/ATR-dependent manner, independently of the kinetochore.
records.note: Low-dose MMS still arrests cells before anaphase through SAC factors and ATM/ATR homologues without requiring functional kinetochores.
records.uncertainty: Damage-triggered alternative arrest, not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Bioinformatics Identification of Regulatory Genes and Mechanism Related to Hypoxia-Induced PD-L1 Inhibitor Resistance in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.

administered_agents.name: unnamed anti-angiogenic agent
administered_agents.role: clinical combination context, not a new administered experiment

records.note: Hypoxia overlap and PD-L1 regulatory analyses nominate POLE2, GABARAPL1, PIK3R1, NDC80 and TPX2 as response/survival factors.
records.uncertainty: Drug identities and cohort-specific treatment details absent; no tested reversal of resistance here.

records.title: Ensemble decision of local similarity indices on the biological network for disease related gene prediction.
records.model: Five cancer types and human interaction networks
records.note: Majority voting over local similarity indices predicts disease genes, with strong overlap performance from Adamic-Adar/resource-allocation methods.
records.uncertainty: No administered drugs or efficacy evidence.

records.title: Inhibition of the serine/threonine kinase BUB1 reverses taxane resistance in prostate cancer.
records.model: Taxane-resistant CRPC cells including AR-variant models
records.note: BUB1 inhibition restores taxane sensitivity even with constitutively active AR variants; AR-V7 raises BUB1 and reduces taxane response.
records.uncertainty: Both inhibitor and taxane names absent; BUB1 differs from BUB1B and anticancer checkpoint disruption is not MVA restoration.

records.title: Aneuploidy arises at early stages of Apc-driven intestinal tumorigenesis and pinpoints conserved chromosomal loci of allelic imbalance between mouse and human.
records.model: Apc-mutant mouse intestinal adenomas with KRAS or p53 alterations
records.note: Aneuploidy appears early after Apc disruption; p53 loss further increases whole-chromosome changes, unlike KRAS activation, with conserved human loci.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic intervention.

records.title: The RAS GTPase RIT1 compromises mitotic fidelity through spindle assembly checkpoint suppression.
records.model: Mitotic cells with pathogenic RIT1 levels
records.note: RIT1 interacts with MAD2/p31comet under CDK1 regulation; pathogenic excess sequesters MAD2, shortens mitosis and increases segregation errors/aneuploidy.
records.uncertainty: A survival-signaling regulator can impair checkpoint fidelity; no drug rescue tested.

records.title: Aurora kinase inhibitors--rising stars in cancer therapeutics?

administered_agents.name: unnamed Aurora kinase inhibitors
administered_agents.role: reviewed preclinical and clinical anticancer agents

records.note: Reviews Aurora-A/B overexpression and mitotic signaling as anticancer targets under clinical and laboratory investigation.
records.uncertainty: Drug names and trial outcomes absent; no constitutional aneuploidy treatment evidence.

records.title: The role of genetic and epigenetic factors in sports-related muscle, bone, and brain injuries.
records.model: Sports-related muscle, bone and brain injuries
records.note: Reviews ACE/ACTN3/AMPD1/VDR/APOE variants and miRNA associations with injury and recovery, emphasizing weak functional validation and cohort heterogeneity.
records.uncertainty: No administered regenerative or muscle-compensating therapy.

records.title: Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts Foster a High-Lactate Microenvironment to Drive Perineural Invasion in Pancreatic Cancer.

administered_agents.name: lactate
administered_agents.role: CAF-derived tumor metabolite driving histone lactylation

administered_agents.name: unnamed GAPDH/lactylation-targeting interventions
administered_agents.role: experimental interventions; drug versus genetic identity unspecified

records.model: Pancreatic cancer, CAFs and genetically engineered mice
records.note: CAF glycolysis supplies lactate for H3K18 lactylation and L1CAM/SLIT1 expression; targeting GAPDH/lactylation reduces neural invasion in mice.
records.uncertainty: Intervention identities/modalities need primary identification; no nerve regeneration or BUB1B benefit shown.

records.title: NAD<sup>+</sup> Metabolism as an Emerging Therapeutic Target for Cardiovascular Diseases Associated With Sudden Cardiac Death.

administered_agents.name: unnamed NAD+-boosting therapies
administered_agents.role: reviewed human cardiovascular approaches, not administered by review

records.note: Connects NAD+ homeostasis to cardiac disease and summarizes human NAD+-boosting progress and unresolved challenges.
records.uncertainty: Abstract lacks precursor identities and measured cardiac outcomes; cannot attribute benefit specifically to niacin.

records.title: Jejunal Cancer with WRN Mutation Identified from Next-Generation Sequencing: A Case Study and Minireview.
records.note: Sequencing identifies WRN mutations after pathology excluded typical colorectal/MSI findings; treatment comprises resection and ongoing chemotherapy.
records.uncertainty: Chemotherapy identity and response absent; WRN mutation alone is not evidence of Werner syndrome or BUB1B disease.

records.title: A novel protein phosphatase 1-dependent spindle checkpoint silencing mechanism.
records.note: Ark1 inhibition disassembles checkpoint complexes and degrades cyclin B despite unattached kinetochores, requiring kinetochore PP1/Dis2.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor identity absent; premature checkpoint silencing is mechanistic bypass, not chromosome repair.

records.title: PP2A holoenzymes, substrate specificity driving cellular functions and deregulation in cancer.
records.model: PP2A holoenzyme structure and cancer signaling
records.note: Explains how A/C cores and diverse B subunits specify substrates and localizations, producing both positive and negative regulation of growth and division.
records.uncertainty: No PP2A drug or disease rescue in abstract.

records.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of the Downregulation of miRNA-1827 and Its Prognostic Significance by Targeting SPTBN2 and BCL2L1 in Ovarian Cancer.
records.note: miR-1827 is reduced in tumors; mimic transfection inhibits proliferation, while predicted downstream SPTBN2/BCL2L1 associate with adverse prognosis.
records.uncertainty: RNA mimic and target associations, not an available therapeutic drug or BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Enhanced recombinant protein production in CHO cell continuous cultures under growth-inhibiting conditions is associated with an arrested cell cycle in G1/G0 phase.
records.note: NaBu and low temperature increased recombinant-protein productivity while arresting G1/G0 through distinct transcriptional programs with additive combined arrest.
records.uncertainty: Industrial production endpoint; growth inhibition is not restoration of tissue health.

records.title: Gut transcriptomic changes during hibernation in the greater horseshoe bat (Rhinolophus ferrumequinum).
records.model: Greater horseshoe bat gut across hibernation states
records.note: Torpor/arousal alter intake, ketogenesis, autophagy and innate-immune genes; CCK/GPR17, HMGCS2 and TEX264 accompany fasting adaptation.
records.uncertainty: Natural physiology without administered therapeutic agent.

records.title: Probabilistic modeling of cell cycle dynamics in response to cell cycle targeting chemotherapy drugs to guide treatment strategies.

administered_agents.name: three unnamed chemotherapies
administered_agents.role: empirical cell-cycle data used for model calibration

records.note: Model incorporates arrest, apoptosis and damage-propagating checkpoint adaptation; unfaithful-repair parameters strongly influence late predictions.
records.uncertainty: Agent identities absent and predictions depend on fitted assumptions; no therapeutic superiority established.

records.title: Insulin-like growth factor 2 mRNA-binding protein 1 (IGF2BP1) in hematological diseases.
records.model: IGF2BP1 in malignancy and adult hematopoietic progenitors
records.note: Reviews IGF2BP1 oncogenic RNA stabilization and its potential to increase fetal hemoglobin in adult progenitors.
records.uncertainty: Potential hematologic compensation coexists with cancer biology; no named administered drug or benefit magnitude.

records.title: Generation and diversification of recombinant monoclonal antibodies.
records.note: Provides low-cost antibody generation, species retargeting and scFv-to-bivalent conversion methods using mitotic epitopes as examples.
records.uncertainty: Research reagents, not therapeutic antibody efficacy.

records.title: Function and regulation mechanism of Chk1 during meiotic maturation in porcine oocytes.
records.note: Chk1 depletion caused MI arrest, misaligned chromosomes and impaired cyclin-B1 degradation with reduced Mad2L1/Cdh1; overexpression delayed GVBD.
records.uncertainty: Abstract's claim of no GVBD role sits uneasily with overexpression delay; no drug rescue.

records.title: Cc2d1b Contributes to the Regulation of Developmental Myelination in the Central Nervous System.
records.model: Day-30 Cc2d1b-knockout mouse optic and sciatic nerves
records.note: Cc2d1b loss mildly hypomyelinated large optic-nerve fibers while sciatic thickness and surveyed CNS oligodendrocyte/myelin measures were unchanged.
records.uncertainty: Developmental genetic phenotype without treatment or functional neurologic recovery.

records.title: The identification of hub biomarkers and pathways in lung cancer and prognostic evaluation.
records.note: Identifies shared and subtype-specific genes; RRM2, CHEK1, TYMS and SERPINB5 link p53/pyrimidine programs to NSCLC survival.
records.uncertainty: No drug exposure or treatment response.

records.title: The G2-to-M Transition Is Ensured by a Dual Mechanism that Protects Cyclin B from Degradation by Cdc20-Activated APC/C.
records.note: Mad1/Mad2-mediated Cdc20 sequestration and CDK phosphorylation of Cdc20 cooperate to protect cyclin B before mitotic entry.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic regulation without administered therapy.

records.title: Frailty index as a biomarker of lifespan and healthspan: Focus on pharmacological interventions.

administered_agents.name: metformin
administered_agents.role: reviewed aging/frailty intervention, not administered by review

administered_agents.name: rapamycin
administered_agents.role: reviewed aging/frailty intervention, not administered by review

administered_agents.name: resveratrol
administered_agents.role: reviewed aging/frailty intervention, not administered by review

records.model: Mouse frailty/healthspan studies and human translation
records.note: Reviews functional frailty measures across metabolic, sirtuin and senolytic interventions, distinguishing healthspan from survival as an endpoint.
records.uncertainty: No drug-specific outcome magnitude or BUB1B result in abstract; source-specific functional evidence merits appraisal.

records.title: Transcriptome analysis of cardiac endothelial cells after myocardial infarction reveals temporal changes and long-term deficits.
records.model: Mouse cardiac endothelial cells after myocardial infarction
records.note: ECs progress from metabolic/inflammatory activation to proliferative/mesenchymal repair, yet retain inflammatory, thrombotic and fibrotic programs and lose circadian rhythmicity long term.
records.uncertainty: No treatment tested; proliferation during repair does not imply normalization of vascular physiology.

records.title: The proteasome regulates bacterial CpG DNA-induced signaling pathways in murine macrophages.
records.note: Lactacystin completely blocked CpG-induced TNF-alpha and other inflammatory mediator genes; CpG responses were often delayed compared with LPS.
records.uncertainty: Inflammatory marker suppression only; organismal infection control, toxicity and tissue benefit unmeasured.

records.title: Rab5 GTPase controls chromosome alignment through Lamin disassembly and relocation of the NuMA-like protein Mud to the poles during mitosis.
records.note: Rab5 associates with Lamin/Mud and supports nuclear-envelope disassembly and Mud pole localization; Rab5 or Mud loss yields chromosome misalignment.
records.uncertainty: Membrane-trafficking genetics, without drug rescue.
