records.note: Repurposing nominations aim to reverse AURKA, CCNB1, CDK1, RRM2 and TOP2A-associated tumor signatures; no compound efficacy experiment is described.
records.uncertainty: Predictions include antiproliferative/genotoxic drugs and cannot be counted as BUB1B restoration or healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Pediatric Cancer Predisposition and Surveillance Update: Summary Perspective and Future Directions.
records.note: Summarizes 2023 workshop updates to childhood cancer surveillance and prospects for prevention trials across inherited predisposition syndromes.
records.uncertainty: No preventive drug efficacy or MVA treatment in abstract.

records.title: The Ndc80 complex uses a tripartite attachment point to couple microtubule depolymerization to chromosome movement.
records.model: Human NDC80/Hec1 kinetochores and in-vitro binding
records.note: Hec1 calponin-homology mutations prevent productive attachments despite intact checkpoint recruitment; removing Aurora-B sites cannot rescue the defect.
records.uncertainty: Shows structural defects can resist phosphorylation-based compensation; no drug tested.

records.title: Aneuploidy: implications for protein homeostasis and disease.
records.note: Reviews how chromosome-number imbalance affects protein quality control and may contribute to cancer and aging.
records.uncertainty: Therapies are prospective; no named drug or rescue outcome.

records.title: Overexpression of ubiquitin specific protease 44 (USP44) induces chromosomal instability and is frequently observed in human T-cell leukemia.
records.model: Nontransformed mouse fibroblasts and T-cell leukemia expression
records.note: USP44 excess increases MAD2-Cdc20 association and reinforces the checkpoint but still causes segregation errors/aneuploidy; G2 cyclin B1 is stabilized.
records.uncertainty: Important opposing evidence: stronger checkpoint signaling alone is not sufficient for fidelity; no pharmacological intervention.

records.title: The multifaceted roles of the HORMA domain in cellular signaling.
records.model: HORMA-domain signaling across checkpoint, repair and autophagy
records.note: Reviews shared safety-belt peptide binding mechanisms that regulate assembly/disassembly of functionally distinct signaling complexes.
records.uncertainty: No drug testing or tissue rescue.

records.title: The Blood-Brain Barrier and Its Intercellular Junctions in Age-Related Brain Disorders.
records.model: Aging brain microvasculature and neurological disorders
records.note: Reviews tight-junction regulation and age-associated barrier disruption in Alzheimer, Parkinson, Huntington and schizophrenia contexts.
records.uncertainty: No named barrier-restoring therapeutic or measured benefit.

records.title: Oxidative stress activates a specific p53 transcriptional response that regulates cellular senescence and aging.
records.model: p66-deleted mice, fibroblasts and p44/p53 transgenic mice
records.note: p66 deletion blocks a stress-selective p53 mitosis/senescence repression program and increases longevity of p44/p53 transgenic mice.
records.uncertainty: Genetic longevity effect; no administered drug or evidence that indiscriminate p53 suppression is safe or restores BUB1B.

records.title: Analyzing large gene expression and methylation data profiles using StatBicRM: statistical biclustering-based rule mining.
records.note: StatBicRM combines statistical filtering, biclustering and rule mining to identify biomarkers and quantify expression/methylation relations.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Decoding ubiquitin for mitosis.
records.note: Distinguishes proteolytic directionality from nonproteolytic fidelity signals and reviews DUBs/ubiquitin-binding receptors as decoders.
records.uncertainty: No named drug or restorative outcome.

records.title: A hybrid machine learning framework with two-step feature selection for identifying key biomarkers and drug targets in monkeypox.

administered_agents.name: unnamed therapeutic compounds
administered_agents.role: docked to ATG3, TRIM14 and DUOX1; not administered

records.model: Mpox expression datasets and machine-learning networks
records.note: Two-stage feature selection yields biomarkers and docking candidates targeting three host proteins.
records.uncertainty: Compound identities absent; database classification and docking do not establish antiviral efficacy.

records.title: STIL overexpression shortens lifespan and reduces tumor formation in mice.
records.model: STIL-overexpressing fibroblasts and constitutive/skin-specific transgenic mice
records.note: STIL excess causes centrosome amplification, aneuploidy, senescence, microcephaly, perinatal death and shorter lifespan, while reducing spontaneous and induced tumors.
records.uncertainty: Tumor suppression coexists with organismal harm; carcinogen identities absent and not therapeutic candidates.

records.title: Exome and genome sequencing of nasopharynx cancer identifies NF-κB pathway activating mutations.
records.note: NF-kappaB suppressor mutations occur in 41%; CYLD loss promotes growth and somatic pathway changes are mutually exclusive with viral LMP1 overexpression.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic compound tested.

records.title: Combinations of Low-Frequency Genetic Variants Might Predispose to Familial Pancreatic Cancer.
records.note: Families carry rare variants across ATM, SUFU, DAB1, POLQ and other genes, sometimes in combinations and with incomplete penetrance.
records.uncertainty: No intervention; candidate polygenic predisposition does not identify a drug.

records.title: Evaluation of crizotinib as radiosensitizer in sacral chordoma cells: effects of combined carbon ion particle therapy.

administered_agents.name: crizotinib
administered_agents.role: administered ALK/MET inhibitor as radiosensitizer candidate

records.model: Two human sacral chordoma cell lines under carbon-ion irradiation
records.note: Carbon ions induce G2/M arrest and damage responses; crizotinib lowers proliferation markers and partly suppresses signaling, but added radiosensitization is limited.
records.uncertainty: Preserves negative result: marker modulation is not strong radiation efficacy, clinical benefit or BUB1B rescue.

records.title: DREAM and RB cooperate to induce gene repression and cell-cycle arrest in response to p53 activation.
records.model: LIN37/DREAM and RB knockout cells under p53 activation
records.note: LIN37 loss partly weakens repression; combined LIN37/RB loss abolishes p53-dependent cell-cycle-gene suppression and the G1/S checkpoint.
records.uncertainty: Activation method unspecified; genetic checkpoint bypass is not repair.

records.title: Dual regulation of Mad2 localization on kinetochores by Bub1 and Dam1/DASH that ensure proper spindle interaction.
records.model: Fission yeast Bub1 and Dam1/DASH pathways
records.note: Bub1 and Dam1/DASH separately help Mad2 sense tensionless versus unattached kinetochores; dual loss speeds mitosis despite segregation errors.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacological intervention and Bub1 is distinct from BUB1B.

records.title: Crosstalk along the gut-liver axis modulates glutathione and cadmium-induced hepatotoxicity.

administered_agents.name: morin
administered_agents.role: described preclinical flavonoid candidate; underlying administration not established from mismatched source

administered_agents.name: cisplatin
administered_agents.role: described combination chemotherapy and nephrotoxicity exposure

records.model: Described HCC and toxin-induced liver injury; title concerns cadmium gut-liver effects
records.note: Saved text says morin reduces oxidative/inflammatory liver injury, sensitizes HCC to cisplatin through PARP1/autophagy and mitigates nephrotoxicity.
records.uncertainty: Title/abstract mismatch: morin therapeutic summary does not match cadmium gut-liver title; verify source before crediting any drug, mechanism or benefit.

records.title: Genome-Wide DNA Methylation Patterns of Bovine Blastocysts Developed In Vivo from Embryos Completed Different Stages of Development In Vitro.
records.model: Bovine embryos transferred in vivo after different in-vitro stages
records.note: Longer in-vitro development correlates with stage-specific methylation disruption; methylation changes explain only a minority of altered gene expression.
records.uncertainty: No named culture drug or therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Biology of Pellino1: a potential therapeutic target for inflammation in diseases and cancers.
records.model: Pellino1 signaling across inflammation, infection and cancer
records.note: Peli1 is described as adverse in many cancers but protective in HSV, lupus, esophageal cancer and toxic epidermolysis, underscoring context-dependent ubiquitin signaling.
records.uncertainty: No named Peli1 drug or intervention outcome.

records.title: Molecular Biology in the Breast Clinics-Current status and future perspectives.
records.model: Breast-cancer molecular subtypes and therapeutic selection
records.note: Reviews individualized targeted/immunotherapy selection and molecular-test limitations in heterogeneous breast cancer.
records.uncertainty: No named drug or quantified efficacy in abstract.

records.title: The role of demethylase AlkB homologs in cancer.
records.note: Surveys nine demethylases, substrates and roles in tumor growth and spread, proposing future diagnostic/therapeutic targeting.
records.uncertainty: Endogenous iron/alpha-ketoglutarate cofactors are not administered treatments; no drug tested.

records.title: TK1 expression influences pathogenicity by cell cycle progression, cellular migration, and cellular survival in HCC 1806 breast cancer cells.
records.model: HCC1806 breast-cancer cells versus TK1-knockdown L133
records.note: TK1-associated changes in p21/AKT3 accompany differences in cycle progression, survival and migration, supporting a role beyond a proliferation marker.
records.uncertainty: No administered drug or BUB1B rescue; direction of individual cell-cycle effects is not fully resolved in abstract.

records.title: CENP-F-dependent DRP1 function regulates APC/C activity during oocyte meiosis I.
records.note: CENP-F recruits DRP1 to kinetochores; DRP1 binds APC2 to restrain APC/C, and acute loss prematurely degrades securin/cyclin B1 and activates separase.
records.uncertainty: A mitochondrial-fission protein has a nonmitochondrial checkpoint role; no named DRP1 drug or restoration tested.

records.title: Whole chromosome aneuploidy: big mutations drive adaptation by phenotypic leap.
records.note: Distinguishes aneuploidy-driven cellular stress adaptation and population diversity from detrimental effects on multicellular organisms.
records.uncertainty: Cell-population fitness is not evidence of patient benefit; no drug intervention.

records.title: Prognostic stratification in hepatocellular carcinoma using a telomerase-related lncRNA signature derived from TCGA database.
records.model: TCGA HCC and pilot clinical expression validation
records.note: Four telomerase-related lncRNAs stratify survival; high-risk tumors have higher immune/checkpoint expression and predicted immunotherapy resistance.
records.uncertainty: Drug names and measured treatment efficacy absent; pilot qPCR validates expression only.

records.title: Primary malignant tumors of the adrenal glands.
records.note: Reviews steroid-secreting adrenal malignancies and catecholamine-type presentations, emphasizing invasion/metastasis in malignant PPGL classification.
records.uncertainty: No administered drug or therapeutic outcome.

records.title: Affected chromosome homeostasis and genomic instability of clonal yeast cultures.
records.model: Clonal yeast with checkpoint, repair or TOR1 mutations
records.note: Checkpoint/repair mutants show chromosome fragility and aneuploid events; tor1 longevity mutants retain the most balanced chromosomes among tested strains.
records.uncertainty: TOR1 deletion differs from rapamycin treatment and does not establish mammalian BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Identification of novel mitosis regulators through data mining with human centromere/kinetochore proteins as group queries.
records.note: Queries 196 curated kinetochore proteins to identify KIAA1377 localization and TRIP13 interaction with p31comet.
records.uncertainty: Protein discovery, without administered therapeutic agent.

records.title: CANVS: an easy-to-use application for the analysis and visualization of mass spectrometry-based protein-protein interaction/association data.
records.note: CANVS combines cleaning, interactive network visualization and BioGRID/CORUM/GO context for proteomic interactions.
records.uncertainty: Software, without biological treatment testing.

records.title: Cell-cycle and apoptosis related and proteomics-based signaling pathways of human hepatoma Huh-7 cells treated by three currently used multi-RTK inhibitors.

administered_agents.name: sorafenib
administered_agents.role: administered multi-RTK inhibitor at its IC50

administered_agents.name: lenvatinib
administered_agents.role: administered multi-RTK inhibitor at its IC50

administered_agents.name: regorafenib
administered_agents.role: administered multi-RTK inhibitor at its IC50

records.note: Lenvatinib/regorafenib produced stronger G0/G1 arrest than sorafenib; lenvatinib favored early apoptosis, while regorafenib produced more necrosis and both strongly reduced Mad2/cell-cycle proteins.
records.uncertainty: Comparisons at respective IC50s are mechanistic, not equal-exposure clinical superiority; checkpoint-protein suppression is not restoration.

records.title: A human B-cell interactome identifies MYB and FOXM1 as master regulators of proliferation in germinal centers.
records.note: MYB and FOXM1 jointly regulate a proliferation module spanning DNA licensing, replication and mitosis; most shared targets activate in germinal centers.
records.uncertainty: No drug or disease rescue; FOXM1 induction can support normal immune proliferation as well as other contexts.

records.title: Molecular pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease onset in a mouse model: effects of cannabidiol treatment.

administered_agents.name: cannabidiol (CBD)
administered_agents.role: administered dietary 80-100 mg/kg/day for two months

records.model: Male 3xTg-AD and wild-type mice, age 4.5-6.5 months
records.note: CBD eliminated or reversed expression direction for over 75% of more than 1,000 AD-onset markers across neurovascular, synaptic and metabolic pathways.
records.uncertainty: Behavioral assays are mentioned but no behavioral benefit is reported in this abstract; transcript reversal does not prove functional or BUB1B rescue.

records.title: RecurIndex assay as an aid for adjuvant chemotherapy decisions in HR-positive HER2-negative breast cancer patients.

administered_agents.name: unnamed adjuvant chemotherapy
administered_agents.role: received by subsets of breast-cancer cohort

records.note: RecurIndex stratified seven-year recurrence risk, but chemotherapy-associated survival differences were nonsignificant in both risk groups.
records.uncertainty: Observational selection and power limit inference; regimens absent and high-risk benefit remains unresolved.

records.title: A robust six-gene prognostic signature based on two prognostic subtypes constructed by chromatin regulators is correlated with immunological features and therapeutic response in lung adenocarcinoma.
records.note: Six-gene risk groups validated across nine datasets; low-risk tumors were linked to better immunotherapy response but less chemotherapy sensitivity.
records.uncertainty: Abstract does not cleanly distinguish measured from predicted treatment effects or identify drugs.

records.title: Normal viability of Kai1/Cd82 deficient mice.
records.note: Deletion preserved viability, fertility and surveyed tissues through 12-18 months despite sex-dependent expression changes enriched for division in male fibroblasts.
records.uncertainty: Negative phenotype under tested conditions; no administered therapeutic and no stress/metastasis efficacy demonstrated.

records.title: Identification of key genes induced by platelet-rich plasma in human dermal papilla cells using bioinformatics methods.

administered_agents.name: platelet-rich plasma (PRP)
administered_agents.role: administered mixed biologic to cultured dermal-papilla cells

records.model: Two treated and two control human hair dermal-papilla samples
records.note: PRP-associated transcripts emphasize CDK1, PLK1, CDC20, cyclin B1 and AURKB induction with lower MYC, suggesting cell-cycle effects.
records.uncertainty: Very small transcriptomic comparison; no direct hair-regrowth endpoint and abstract transcript counts are inconsistent.

records.title: Targeting senescence to delay progression of multiple sclerosis.

administered_agents.name: unnamed senolytics
administered_agents.role: proposed progressive-MS treatments; prior benefits in other neurological animal models reviewed

records.model: Progressive multiple sclerosis and aging CNS
records.note: Proposes testing senescent-cell elimination only after showing a causal contribution to MS progression, citing animal benefits in other neurological diseases.
records.uncertainty: No senolytic identity, MS intervention or tissue replacement demonstrated; clearance is not BUB1B restoration.

records.title: Centromere targeting of the chromosomal passenger complex requires a ternary subcomplex of Borealin, Survivin, and the N-terminal domain of INCENP.
records.model: CPC targeting in cells and in vitro
records.note: Survivin, Borealin and INCENP's first 58 residues form a sufficient centromere-targeting module independently of Aurora-B activity, CENP-A and hMis12.
records.uncertainty: No drug treatment or disease rescue.

records.title: Identification of hub genes and therapeutic drugs in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma based on integrated bioinformatics strategy.
records.model: 63 paired ESCC/normal tissues and qPCR validation
records.note: Cell-cycle/replication hubs and survival-associated NDC80 motivate 33 database drug candidates.
records.uncertainty: Drug identities and efficacy absent from abstract; qPCR validates gene expression only.

records.title: Overlapping and distinct pRb pathways in the mammalian auditory and vestibular organs.
records.model: Mouse cochlear and utricular hair cells, embryonic versus adult deletion
records.note: Embryonic Rb1 loss permits proliferation but harms cochlear survival while utricular cells survive; acute adult loss produces neither proliferation nor death.
records.uncertainty: No administered regenerative drug; age and organ differences prevent generalizing cell-cycle release as sensory repair.

records.title: A mechanism that integrates microtubule motors of opposite polarity at the kinetochore corona
records.model: Kinetochore corona and motor-protein reconstitution/cell studies
records.note: CENP-E retains RZZS under MPS1 inhibition, a requirement bypassed by phosphomimetic RZZS; with active MPS1 it remains necessary for dynein loading.
records.uncertainty: Preprint record; inhibitor identity absent and mutant bypass is not therapeutic BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Protein Ontology (PRO): enhancing and scaling up the representation of protein entities.
records.note: Standardizes proteoform representation with UniProt/PSI-MOD and expands text mining, dynamic terms and semantic querying.
records.uncertainty: No biological treatment.

records.title: The Host Cell ViroCheckpoint: Identification and Pharmacologic Targeting of Novel Mechanistic Determinants of Coronavirus-Mediated Hijacked Cell States

administered_agents.name: 133 unnamed approved and 195 unnamed experimental compounds
administered_agents.role: existing perturbation profiles used for virtual signature reversal

records.note: VIPER/OncoTreat identifies host master-regulator signatures and computationally prioritizes drugs predicted to reverse the infected cell state.
records.uncertainty: Preprint; no named drugs or experimental viral-suppression outcome, and extension to SARS-CoV-2 is proposed.

records.title: High resolution profiling of cell cycle-dependent protein and phosphorylation abundance changes in non-transformed cells
records.model: Nontransformed hTERT-RPE-1 cells across the cell cycle
records.note: Deep quantitative proteomics maps temporal abundance/phosphorylation and mitotic-exit degradation for an interactive reference database.
records.uncertainty: Preprint resource; no named intervention or therapeutic benefit.

records.title: Unravelling Multilayered RNA Modification Networks in Female Reproduction and Obstetric/Gynaecologic Disorders.
records.model: RNA modifications in female reproduction and gynecologic disorders
records.note: Integrates writer/eraser/reader networks and modification crosstalk across gametes, embryos, placenta and disease.
records.uncertainty: Reversibility suggests targets but no named therapeutic administration or rescue.

records.title: HepG2.2.15-derived exosomes facilitate the activation and fibrosis of hepatic stellate cells.

administered_agents.name: 5-ethynyl-2'-deoxyuracil (as reported)
administered_agents.role: proliferation staining reagent; source nomenclature uncertain

records.note: Tumor-cell-derived exosomes increased stellate activation, proliferation and fibrosis with 27 altered miRNAs and MAPK/ubiquitin/viral pathway targets.
records.uncertainty: Exosomes are pathogenic exposure, not regenerative therapy; assay nucleotide name is unusual and not independently verified.

records.title: Targeting MAD2 modulates stemness and tumorigenesis in human Gastric Cancer cell lines.
records.model: Gastric cancer stem-cell lines and nude-mouse xenografts
records.note: MAD2 downregulation reduced stemness markers, migration/invasion and tumor growth while leaving cell-cycle profile and therapy resistance unchanged.
records.uncertainty: Activity-modulation method and therapies unspecified; no named drug and cancer-cell suppression differs from SAC restoration.

records.title: The Genomic Landscape of Intrinsic and Acquired Resistance to Cyclin-Dependent Kinase 4/6 Inhibitors in Patients with Hormone Receptor-Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer.
records.model: 59 HR-positive metastatic breast tumors and resistant cell models
records.note: Eight mechanisms account for 66% of resistant tumors; selected RB1/KRAS/AURKA/CCNE2 changes confer alternative kinase-inhibitor sensitivities.
records.uncertainty: Individual compound identities and context-specific effects require source identification; no normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: Checkpoint kinase 1 (Chk1) is required for mitotic progression through negative regulation of polo-like kinase 1 (Plk1).
records.note: Chk1 depletion dysregulates PLK1, causes chromosome misalignment/lagging, G2/M arrest and apoptosis; checkpoint co-depletion relieves arrest.
records.uncertainty: Relieving arrest is not proof of rescued chromosome fidelity or survival; no therapeutic drug tested.

records.title: Cellular senescence and Alzheimer disease: the egg and the chicken scenario.
records.model: Aging, Alzheimer disease, neurons and glia
records.note: Reviews whether chronic senescence precedes or follows neurodegeneration and proposes ablation while acknowledging insufficient causal evidence.
records.uncertainty: No named senolytic or measured AD rescue; clearance cannot be equated with neuronal replacement.

records.title: PLK2 as a key regulator of glycolysis and immune dysregulation in polycystic ovary syndrome.
records.model: PCOS ovarian stromal datasets and rat model
records.note: Endothelial glycolysis and PPIA-BSG communication nominate PLK2, with inflammatory/fibrotic pathway associations and DHEA-model validation.
records.uncertainty: DHEA is the disease-induction agent; no PLK2 inhibitor or therapeutic fertility benefit tested.

records.title: MdmX regulates transformation and chromosomal stability in p53-deficient cells.
records.model: p53-deficient cells/mice with or without MdmX
records.note: Endogenous MdmX suppresses multipolar mitosis/transformation in hyperploid p53-null cells through functions distinct from its p53 inhibition.
records.uncertainty: No administered MdmX modulator; context-specific genetics cannot establish a general therapeutic direction.

records.title: Identification of genes associated with laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma samples based on bioinformatic analysis.
records.note: Tumor-associated expression programs are enriched for cell division and focal adhesion, with markedly different DEG counts across datasets.
records.uncertainty: No drug or therapeutic response.

records.title: Integrated genomics and functional validation identifies malignant cell specific dependencies in triple negative breast cancer.
records.note: RNAi validates 37 of 130 predicted dependencies; KIFC1/HSET supports bipolar division specifically in centrosome-amplified malignant cells.
records.uncertainty: No named KIFC1 drug; selective cancer dependency does not demonstrate BUB1B restoration.

records.title: Antitumoral activity of the mithralog EC-8042 in triple negative breast cancer linked to cell cycle arrest in G2.
records.model: TNBC cell lines and mouse xenografts
records.note: EC-8042 causes G2 arrest with higher pCDK1/Wee1, delayed mostly caspase-independent apoptosis, tumor-growth suppression and enhanced docetaxel action in vivo.
records.uncertainty: Other partners and quantitative safety margins absent; improved parent-compound toxicology does not establish clinical or MVA benefit.

records.title: Laryngeal embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma in an adult - a case presentation in the eyes of geneticists and clinicians.
records.note: Chemotherapy failed, followed by hemilaryngectomy and 62 months without recurrence; surgery/radiotherapy are discussed as management choices.
records.uncertainty: Drug identity absent and control cannot be credited to chemotherapy; no BUB1B diagnosis shown.

records.title: Expression and prognostic value of CDK1, CCNA2, and CCNB1 gene clusters in human breast cancer.
records.note: CDK1, CCNA2 and CCNB1 are higher in tumors/advanced stages and associate with survival and recurrence metrics.
records.uncertainty: No administered cell-cycle drug or therapeutic validation.

records.title: A dichotomy of gene regulatory associations during the activated B-cell to plasmablast transition.
records.model: Human activated B cells transitioning to plasmablasts
records.note: Removing CD40-mediated input rapidly increases proliferation/ER-stress and ASC programs; IRF4/XBP1 associate with induction whereas BLIMP1 tracks repression.
records.uncertainty: Signal withdrawal is not a named drug treatment; no disease rescue.

records.title: Hec1/Ndc80 Tail Domain Function at the Kinetochore-Microtubule Interface.
records.note: Reviews how the disordered Hec1 tail generates and tunes force-bearing attachments while preserving error correction.
records.uncertainty: No named intervention or functional rescue.

records.title: Cenp-E inhibitor GSK923295: Novel synthetic route and use as a tool to generate aneuploidy.

administered_agents.name: GSK923295
administered_agents.role: administered CENP-E inhibitor leaving polar chromosomes

administered_agents.name: AZ3146
administered_agents.role: administered MPS1 inhibitor forcing anaphase entry

records.note: Sequential CENP-E and MPS1 inhibition induces about two missegregation events per division while avoiding midzone chromosome trapping.
records.uncertainty: These drugs generate aneuploidy as research tools; they are opposing evidence for chromosome-restoration use.

records.title: A New Frameshift Mutation of PTEN Gene Associated with Cowden Syndrome-Case Report and Brief Review of the Literature.
records.note: Early tonsil polyps preceded recognition of extensive intestinal polyposis and a PTEN frameshift diagnosis at age 20.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic intervention or BUB1B-related syndrome.

records.title: The spindle checkpoint and chromosome segregation in meiosis.
records.note: Explains how meiotic systems established checkpoint concepts and how force, attachment and protein modification govern two sequential divisions.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or infertility rescue.

records.title: CRISPR/Cas technologies in pancreatic cancer research and therapeutics: recent advances and future outlook.
records.model: CRISPR/Cas in pancreatic-cancer models and therapies
records.note: Reviews genome editing for oncogene silencing, pathogenic-variant correction and disease-model construction.
records.uncertainty: No specific drug or demonstrated therapeutic gene-editing result in abstract.

records.title: Profiling age-related epigenetic markers of stomach adenocarcinoma in young and old subjects.
records.note: Older tumors show higher cell-cycle and lower muscle/adhesion programs plus promoter hypomethylation of ELF3, IL1-beta and MMP13.
records.uncertainty: Tumor age associations do not establish muscle deterioration or a restorative intervention.
